title_en: AgentSteerTTS: A Multi-Agent Closed-Loop Framework for Composite-Instruction Text-to-Speech
title_zh: AgentSteerTTS：面向复合指令文本转语音的多智能体闭环框架

sentences.en: While existing text-to-speech (TTS) models exhibit high expressiveness, fine-grained control over composite instructions remains challenging due to the structural mismatch between discrete textual intents and continuous acoustic realizations.
sentences.zh: 尽管现有的文本到语音（TTS）模型表现出高度表现力，但由于离散文本意图与连续声学实现之间的结构不匹配，对复合指令的细粒度控制仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Inspired by human cognitive decoupling, we introduce AgentSteerTTS, a multi-agent closed-loop framework designed for intent-faithful expressive control of composite instructions.
sentences.zh: 受人类认知解耦的启发，我们引入 AgentSteerTTS，一个专为复合指令的意图忠实表现力控制而设计的多智能体闭环框架。

sentences.en: First, in our framework, an adversarial disentanglement module mitigates speaker-emotion leakage through gradient reversal and cross-covariance regularization.
sentences.zh: 首先，在我们的框架中，一个对抗式解缠模块通过梯度反转和协交叉正则化来缓解说话者-情感泄漏。

sentences.en: Next, a Dual-Stream Anchoring Controller grounds abstract intents using a large-scale acoustic prototype library: a Retrieval Agent selects expressive anchors, while a Synthesis Agent fuses them into continuous control vectors via gated attention.
sentences.zh: 其次，一个双流锚定控制器利用大规模声学原型库来锚定抽象意图：一个检索智能体选择表现力锚点，而一个合成智能体通过门控注意力将它们融合为连续控制向量。

sentences.en: Finally, a Fast–Slow Feedback Agent refines output intensity through latent gradient correction and resolves semantic–acoustic mismatches using high-level perceptual critique.
sentences.zh: 最后，一个快-慢反馈智能体通过潜在梯度校正精化输出强度，并使用高层感知批评来解决语义-声学不匹配。

sentences.en: Experiments on a composite-instruction benchmark and public test sets show that AgentSteerTTS yields consistent and significant improvements to the baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
sentences.zh: 在复合指令基准和公开测试集上的实验表明，AgentSteerTTS 相对基线产生了一致且显著的改进，证明了所提方法的有效性。

sentences.en: Our code and models will be released.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和模型将公开发布。

title_en: AgentSuite: Toward More Reliable Agent Evaluation with a Component-Based Benchmark Auditing Pipeline
title_zh: AgentSuite：通过组件化基准审计流水线实现更可靠的智能体评估

sentences.en: Reliable evaluation of large language model (LLM) agents depends critically on benchmark validity, yet modern agent benchmarks often contain hidden flaws arising from interactions among user instructions, environments, tools, ground-truth trajectories, and evaluation protocols.
sentences.zh: 对大语言模型（LLM）智能体的可靠评估关键取决于基准的有效性，然而现代智能体基准通常包含源于用户指令、环境、工具、标准答案轨迹和评估协议之间相互作用的隐藏缺陷。

sentences.en: These flaws confound model errors with benchmark artifacts and undermine leaderboard-based comparisons.
sentences.zh: 这些缺陷将模型错误与基准工件混淆在一起，削弱了基于排行榜的比较。

sentences.en: We propose **COBA** (**CO**mponent-based **B**enchmark **A**uditing), an automated pipeline for diagnosing and filtering validity issues in agent benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **COBA**（**CO**mponent-based **B**enchmark **A**uditing，基于组件的基准审计），一个用于诊断和过滤智能体基准中有效性问题的自动化流水线。

sentences.en: COBA decomposes agent tasks into four standardized components—User, Environment, Ground Truth, and Evaluation—and operationalizes a component-level issue taxonomy using hybrid rule-based detectors and taxonomy-guided LLM evaluation.
sentences.zh: COBA 将智能体任务分解为四个标准化组件——用户、环境、标准答案和评估——并使用混合的基于规则的检测器和分类学引导的 LLM 评估，将组件级问题分类学付诸实践。

sentences.en: Across six widely used agent benchmarks, COBA achieves strong alignment with expert judgments, with F1 scores between 0.791 and 0.874.
sentences.zh: 在六个广泛使用的智能体基准上，COBA 与专家判断实现了强对齐，F1 分数介于 0.791 到 0.874 之间。

sentences.en: It complements manual verification of $\tau^2$-bench by identifying issues missed due to benchmark complexity, and generalizes to previously unseen benchmarks with minimal adaptation.
sentences.zh: 它通过识别因基准复杂性而被遗漏的问题，补充了对 $\tau^2$-bench 的人工验证，并以最小的适配泛化到先前未见过的基准。

sentences.en: Our analysis shows that benchmark flaws are widespread and materially affect evaluation outcomes, demonstrating that component-based auditing provides a scalable foundation for more reliable and interpretable agent evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，基准缺陷普遍存在并显著影响评估结果，证明了基于组件的审计为更可靠且可解释的智能体评估提供了可扩展的基础。

sentences.en: We release AgentSuite, a unified benchmark-running platform that includes the COBA auditing pipeline and audited benchmark variants: https://github.com/Agent-Suite/AgentSuite.
sentences.zh: 我们发布了 AgentSuite，一个统一的基准运行平台，包含 COBA 审计流水线和审计后的基准变体：https://github.com/Agent-Suite/AgentSuite。

title_en: AgentTailor: A Semantic-Aware LLM-Based Multi-Agent System with Actor-Critic Structure
title_zh: AgentTailor：具有行动者–评论家结构的语义感知大语言模型多智能体系统

sentences.en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems often suffer from high communication cost due to redundant interactions, as existing methods optimize communication structures without explicitly measuring whether exchanged messages contribute to the final decision.
sentences.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统往往因为冗余交互而遭受高通信成本的困扰，因为现有方法在优化通信结构时，并未显式衡量所交换的消息是否对最终决策有贡献。

sentences.en: To better utilize the semantic information in the execution stage to further optimize the structure of multi-agent systems and reduce token costs, we propose **AgentTailor**, a cost-aware framework that evaluates the semantic contribution of communication edges via an edge judgment mechanism, and employs an **Edge Prediction Network (EPN)** to estimate edge utilities through virtual execution without invoking LLMs.
sentences.zh: 为了在执行阶段更好地利用语义信息，以进一步优化多智能体系统的结构并降低 token 成本，我们提出 **AgentTailor**，一个成本感知的框架，它通过边判断机制评估通信边的语义贡献，并使用**边预测网络（EPN）**通过虚拟执行来估计边的效用，而无需调用 LLM。

sentences.en: Experiments show that AgentTailor achieves the best average accuracy (91.36\%) on six datasets of diverse fields, while reducing total tokens by 21.2\%--61.6\%.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，AgentTailor 在六个不同领域的数据集上取得了最佳平均准确率（91.36\%），同时将总 token 减少了 21.2\%--61.6\%。

sentences.en: Our work demonstrates that explicitly modeling semantic edge contribution is crucial for scalable and efficient multi-agent systems, providing a principled approach to communication optimization that goes beyond structural heuristics.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作表明，显式建模边的语义贡献对于可扩展且高效的多智能体系统至关重要，为超越结构启发式的通信优化提供了一种原则性方法。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/Pt3Y/AgentTailor.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Pt3Y/AgentTailor 获取。

title_en: AgentVocab: Structure-Aware Vocabulary Adaptation for Efficient LLM Agents
title_zh: AgentVocab：面向高效大语言模型智能体的结构感知词表适配

sentences.en: Recent large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across challenging tasks, enabling their widespread adoption in agentic systems that interact with external tools.
sentences.zh: 近期的大语言模型（LLM）在具有挑战性的任务上展现了强大的能力，使其得以在与外部工具交互的智能体系统中被广泛采用。

sentences.en: In such deployments, however, LLMs are typically trained with general-purpose tokenizers designed for broad language coverage, while their usage is dominated by narrow, structured tool-calling interactions.
sentences.zh: 然而，在此类部署中，LLM 通常配备为广泛语言覆盖而设计的通用分词器进行训练，而其使用却以狭窄、结构化的工具调用交互为主。

sentences.en: This training–deployment mismatch leads to inefficient tokenization, where repetitive structural patterns and frequent semantic units in function calls are fragmented into long sequences of low-level tokens, increasing decoding overhead.
sentences.zh: 这种训练-部署的不匹配导致了低效的分词，函数调用中重复的结构模式和频繁出现的语义单元被拆分成一长串底层 token，增加了解码开销。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce $\textbf{AgentVocab}$, a structure-aware vocabulary adaptation framework for efficient LLM agents.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一差距，我们引入 $\textbf{AgentVocab}$，一个面向高效 LLM 智能体的结构感知词表适配框架。

sentences.en: AgentVocab derives specialized vocabulary entries from real tool-calling traces and adapts the model vocabulary to better reflect structural and semantic regularities, without task-specific schema engineering.
sentences.zh: AgentVocab 从真实的工具调用轨迹中推导出专门的词表条目，并适配模型词表以更好地反映结构和语义的规律性，而无需针对特定任务的模式工程。

sentences.en: Experiments on $\tau$-bench and $\tau^2$-bench show that AgentVocab preserves tool-calling performance while reducing latency relative to the vanilla baseline by 17.7\% and 19.5\%, respectively.
sentences.zh: 在 $\tau$-bench 和 $\tau^2$-bench 上的实验表明，AgentVocab 在保持工具调用性能的同时，相对原始基线分别将延迟降低了 17.7\% 和 19.5\%。

sentences.en: Our approach is orthogonal to existing fine-tuning and agent-training methods and integrates seamlessly into standard agent pipelines.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法与现有的微调和智能体训练方法正交，并能无缝集成到标准智能体流水线中。

sentences.en: Source code and models will be available at https://github.com/Starry-159/AgentVocab.
sentences.zh: 源代码和模型将可在 https://github.com/Starry-159/AgentVocab 获取。

title_en: AgentWebBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Coordination in Agentic Web
title_zh: AgentWebBench：评测智能体式网页中的多智能体协调

sentences.en: Agentic Web is an emerging paradigm where autonomous agents help users use online information.
sentences.zh: 智能体化 Web 是一种新兴范式，其中自主智能体帮助用户使用在线信息。

sentences.en: As the paradigm develops, content providers are also deploying agents to manage their data and serve it through controlled interfaces.
sentences.zh: 随着这一范式的发展，内容提供者也在部署智能体来管理其数据，并通过受控接口提供服务。

sentences.en: This shift moves information access from centralized retrieval to decentralized coordination.
sentences.zh: 这一转变使信息访问从集中式检索转向去中心化协调。

sentences.en: To study this setting, we introduce AgentWebBench, a benchmark that evaluates how well a user agent synthesizes answers by interacting with website-specific content agents.
sentences.zh: 为了研究这一设置，我们引入 AgentWebBench，一个评估用户智能体通过与特定网站的“内容智能体”交互来综合答案的能力的基准。

sentences.en: We evaluate four tasks that cover common web information needs, spanning ranked retrieval (web search, web recommendation) and open-ended synthesis (question answering, deep research).
sentences.zh: 我们评估了覆盖常见 Web 信息需求的四项任务，涵盖排序检索（Web 搜索、Web 推荐）和开放式综合（问答、深度研究）。

sentences.en: Across seven advanced LLMs and three coordination strategies, multi-agent coordination generally lags behind centralized retrieval as expected, because user agent cannot directly access the corpus, but the gap shrinks with model scale and can even outperform centralized retrieval on question answering.
sentences.zh: 在七种先进 LLM 和三种协调策略上，正如预期那样，多智能体协调总体上落后于集中式检索，因为用户智能体无法直接访问语料库，但这种差距会随着模型规模扩大而缩小，甚至在问答任务上可以超越集中式检索。

sentences.en: This benchmark also enables us to study properties of the emerging paradigm of the digital world.
sentences.zh: 这一基准还使我们能够研究数字世界这一新兴范式的特性。

sentences.en: We find that decentralized access concentrates traffic toward a small set of websites, test time scaling improves both interaction reliability and task performance, and strong results require sufficient interactions guided by careful planning.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，去中心化访问将流量集中到一小部分网站，测试时扩展既改善了交互可靠性也改善了任务性能，而强劲的结果需要由精心规划引导的充分交互。

sentences.en: Finally, our failure analysis suggests that user agents need better planning and answer synthesis, while content agents need more reliable retrieval and evidence quality.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们的失败分析表明，用户智能体需要更好的规划和答案综合，而内容智能体需要更可靠的检索和更高的证据质量。

sentences.en: Code, data, and APIs are released on https://github.com/cxcscmu/AgentWebBench.
sentences.zh: 代码、数据和 API 已在 https://github.com/cxcscmu/AgentWebBench 发布。

title_en: AgentXRay: White-Boxing Agentic Systems via Workflow Reconstruction
title_zh: AgentXRay：通过工作流重建使智能体系统白盒化

sentences.en: Large Language Models have shown strong capabilities in complex problem solving, yet many agentic systems remain difficult to interpret and control due to opaque internal workflows.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型在复杂问题求解中展现了强大的能力，然而许多智能体系统由于内部工作流不透明而仍然难以解释和控制。

sentences.en: While some frameworks offer explicit architectures for collaboration, many deployed agentic systems operate as black boxes to users.
sentences.zh: 虽然一些框架提供了显式的协作架构，但许多已部署的智能体系统对用户而言仍然以黑盒方式运作。

sentences.en: We address this by introducing Agentic Workflow Reconstruction (AWR), a new task aiming to synthesize an explicit, interpretable stand-in workflow that approximates a black-box system using only input--output access.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入智能体工作流重构（Agentic Workflow Reconstruction，AWR）来解决这一问题，这是一个新任务，旨在仅利用输入-输出访问，综合出一个显式、可解释的替身工作流来近似黑盒系统。

sentences.en: We propose AgentXRay, a search-based framework that formulates AWR as a combinatorial optimization problem over discrete agent roles and tool invocations in a chain-structured workflow space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 AgentXRay，一个基于搜索的框架，它将 AWR 表述为在链式结构工作流空间上、对离散智能体角色和工具调用的组合优化问题。

sentences.en: Unlike model distillation, AgentXRay produces editable white-box workflows that match target outputs under an observable, output-based proxy metric, without accessing model parameters.
sentences.zh: 与模型蒸馏不同，AgentXRay 产生可编辑的白盒工作流，在可观测的、基于输出的代理指标下匹配目标输出，而无需访问模型参数。

sentences.en: To navigate the vast search space, AgentXRay employs Monte Carlo Tree Search enhanced by a scoring-based Red-Black Pruning mechanism, which dynamically integrates proxy quality with search depth.
sentences.zh: 为了在广阔的搜索空间中导航，AgentXRay 采用蒙特卡洛树搜索，并通过一个基于评分的红黑剪枝机制加以增强，该机制动态地将代理质量与搜索深度整合在一起。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse domains demonstrate that AgentXRay achieves higher proxy similarity and reduces token consumption compared to unpruned search, enabling deeper workflow exploration under fixed iteration budgets.
sentences.zh: 跨多个领域的实验表明，与未剪枝的搜索相比，AgentXRay 实现了更高的代理相似度并减少了 token 消耗，从而在固定的迭代预算下实现更深层次的工作流探索。

title_en: Aggregate Models, Not Explanations: Improving Feature Importance Estimation
title_zh: 聚合模型，而非解释：改进特征重要性估计

sentences.en: Feature-importance methods show promise for transforming machine learning (ML) models from predictive engines into tools for scientific discovery.
sentences.zh: 特征重要性方法有望将机器学习（ML）模型从预测引擎转变为科学发现的工具。

sentences.en: However, expressive models can be unstable due to data sampling and algorithmic stochasticity, leading to inaccurate variable importance estimates, undermining their utility in critical biomedical applications.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于数据采样和算法随机性的影响，表达能力强的模型可能不稳定，导致变量重要性估计不准确，从而削弱它们在关键的生物医学应用中的效用。

sentences.en: While ensembling offers a remedy, the choice between explaining a single ensemble model or aggregating individual model explanations is non-trivial due to the non-linearity of importance measures, and remains largely understudied.
sentences.zh: 虽然集成提供了一种补救措施，但由于重要性度量的非线性，选择解释单个集成模型还是聚合单个模型的解释并非易事，并且在很大程度上仍未得到充分研究。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis, developed under assumptions accommodating complex state-of-the-art ML models, reveals that this choice is governed by a trade-off involving the model's excess risk.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析在容纳复杂的最新 ML 模型的假设下展开，揭示了这一选择受到一个涉及模型超额风险的权衡的支配。

sentences.en: In contrast to prior literature, we show that ensembling at the model level provides more accurate variable-importance estimates, particularly for expressive models, by reducing this leading error term.
sentences.zh: 与先前的文献相反，我们表明在模型层面进行集成能提供更准确的变量重要性估计，尤其是对于表达能力强的模型，这是通过减小这一主导误差项实现的。

sentences.en: We validate these findings on classical benchmarks and a large-scale proteomic study from the UK Biobank.
sentences.zh: 我们在经典基准以及英国生物银行（UK Biobank）的一项大规模蛋白质组学研究上验证了这些发现。

title_en: AGoQ: Activation and Gradient Quantization for Memory-Efficient Distributed Training of LLMs
title_zh: AGoQ：通过激活与梯度量化实现内存高效的大语言模型分布式训练

sentences.en: Quantization is a key method for reducing the GPU memory requirement of training large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 量化是降低大语言模型（LLM）训练 GPU 内存需求的关键方法。

sentences.en: Yet, current approaches are ineffective for 4-bit activations and 8-bit gradients, which would easily cause slow convergence or accuracy loss.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的方法对 4 位激活和 8 位梯度并不有效，这些做法很容易导致收敛缓慢或精度损失。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce AGoQ, incorporating two new techniques: 1) a layer-aware activation quantization algorithm that allocates appropriate bit-widths for activations of various layers based on their types and pipeline stages to achieve near 4-bit activation storage, and 2) a gradient quantization algorithm that reduces memory usage and shortens communication time by employing 8-bit gradient storage and precision-preserving 8-bit All-Reduce communication.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们引入 AGoQ，它包含两项新技术：1）一种层级感知的激活量化算法，根据各层激活的类型和流水线阶段为其分配适当的位宽，以实现接近 4 位的激活存储；以及 2）一种梯度量化算法，通过采用 8 位梯度存储和保持精度的 8 位全归约通信，来减少内存使用并缩短通信时间。

sentences.en: We conduct extensive experiments using different sizes of LLMs on two GPU clusters (up to 64 GPUs), and the experimental results show that our AGoQ reduces the memory by up to 52\% and achieves up to 1.34$\times$ improvement of training speed compared to state-of-the-art training systems Megatron-LM (w/ or w/o ZeRO), COAT and DeepSpeed with 8B to 32B LLaMA models, while achieving convergence loss on pretraining and comparable accuracy on downstream tasks with LLaMA architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个 GPU 集群（最多 64 个 GPU）上使用不同规模的 LLM 进行了大量实验，实验结果表明，与最先进的训练系统 Megatron-LM（带或不带 ZeRO）、COAT 和 DeepSpeed（使用 8B 至 32B 的 LLaMA 模型）相比，我们的 AGoQ 将内存减少了多达 52\%，训练速度提升了多达 1.34$\times$，同时在预训练上取得相当的收敛损失，并在下游任务上使用 LLaMA 架构取得了可比的准确率。

title_en: Agora: Toward Autonomous Bug Detection in Production-Level Consensus Protocols with LLM Agents
title_zh: Agora：利用大语言模型智能体自主检测生产级共识协议中的缺陷

sentences.en: Consensus protocols form the backbone of distributed systems and blockchains, where implementation bugs can cause data corruption and financial losses.
sentences.zh: 共识协议构成了分布式系统和区块链的骨干，其中的实现缺陷可能导致数据损坏和财务损失。

sentences.en: While LLM-based approaches show promise in code analysis, they struggle with deep protocol-level logic bugs involving complex state-dependent behaviors across multiple execution stages.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于 LLM 的方法在代码分析方面展现出前景，但它们在涉及跨多个执行阶段、复杂的依赖状态的深层协议级逻辑缺陷上仍然困难重重。

sentences.en: We present Agora, a domain-aware multi-agent framework that integrates hypothesis-driven testing with LLM capabilities for systematic protocol verification.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 Agora，一个领域感知的多智能体框架，它将假设驱动的测试与 LLM 能力相结合，用于系统性的协议验证。

sentences.en: Agora employs specialized agents that collaboratively explore protocol state spaces, synthesize attack scenarios using domain-specific constraints, and validate findings through iterative refinement.
sentences.zh: Agora 采用专门的智能体，它们协作地探索协议状态空间，利用领域特定的约束来综合攻击场景，并通过迭代精化来验证发现。

sentences.en: This explicit role separation enables reasoning about global protocol invariants beyond single-function code analysis.
sentences.zh: 这种显式的角色分离使得能够推理超越单函数代码分析的全局协议不变量。

sentences.en: We evaluate Agora on four consensus implementations (Raft, EPaxos, HotStuff, BullShark) using four state-of-the-art LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们在四个共识实现（Raft、EPaxos、HotStuff、BullShark）上使用四种最先进的 LLM 对 Agora 进行了评估。

sentences.en: Agora discovers 15 previously unknown protocol-level logic bugs that violate safety properties, while existing LLM-based agents fail to detect any such protocol-level logic bugs.
sentences.zh: Agora 发现了 15 个先前未知的、违反安全性质的协议级逻辑缺陷，而现有的基于 LLM 的智能体却无法检测到任何此类协议级逻辑缺陷。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that domain-aware multi-agent collaboration is essential for detecting deep logic bugs in complex protocols.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果证明，领域感知的多智能体协作对于检测复杂协议中的深层逻辑缺陷至关重要。

title_en: AGZO: Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order Optimization for LLM Fine-Tuning
title_zh: AGZO：用于大语言模型微调的激活引导零阶优化

sentences.en: Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising solution for fine-tuning LLMs under strict memory constraints, as it avoids the prohibitive memory cost of storing activations for backpropagation.
sentences.zh: 零阶（ZO）优化已作为在严格内存约束下微调 LLM 的一个有前景的解决方案而出现，因为它避免了为反向传播存储激活所带来的高昂内存成本。

sentences.en: However, existing ZO methods typically employ isotropic perturbations, neglecting the rich structural information available during the forward pass.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 ZO 方法通常采用各向同性的扰动，忽视了前向传播过程中可获得的丰富结构信息。

sentences.en: In this paper, we identify a crucial link between gradient formation and activation structure: the gradient of a linear layer is confined to the subspace spanned by its input activations.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们识别出梯度形成与激活结构之间的一个关键联系：线性层的梯度被限制在其输入激活所张成的子空间内。

sentences.en: Leveraging this insight, we propose Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order optimization (AGZO).
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出激活引导的零阶优化（AGZO）。

sentences.en: Unlike prior methods, AGZO extracts a compact, activation-informed subspace on the fly during the forward pass and restricts perturbations to this low-rank subspace.
sentences.zh: 与先前的方法不同，AGZO 在前向传播过程中即时提取一个紧凑的、由激活信息引导的子空间，并将扰动限制在这一低秩子空间内。

sentences.en: We provide a theoretical framework showing that AGZO optimizes a subspace-smoothed objective and provably yields update directions with higher cosine similarity to the true gradient than isotropic baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了一个理论框架，表明 AGZO 优化的是一个子空间平滑的目标，并且可证明地产生比各向同性基线更接近真实梯度（以余弦相似度衡量）的更新方向。

sentences.en: Empirically, we evaluate AGZO on Qwen3 and Pangu models across various benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在实证方面，我们在多种基准上对 Qwen3 和 Pangu 模型评估了 AGZO。

sentences.en: AGZO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art ZO baselines and significantly narrows the performance gap with first-order fine-tuning, while maintaining almost the same peak memory footprint as other ZO methods.
sentences.zh: AGZO 一致地超越了最先进的 ZO 基线，并显著缩小了与一阶微调之间的性能差距，同时保持与其他 ZO 方法几乎相同的峰值内存占用。

title_en: AI Cartography: Mapping the Latent Landscape of AI Benchmark Ecosystems
title_zh: AI 制图学：绘制 AI 基准生态系统的潜在版图

sentences.en: While aggregate leaderboard scores drive AI development, they contain substantial measurement noise whose sources and magnitudes remain unquantified, making it unclear when rankings reflect genuine capability differences versus evaluation artifacts.
sentences.zh: 虽然聚合排行榜分数推动了 AI 的发展，但它们包含大量测量噪声，这些噪声的来源和大小尚未被量化，使得人们不清楚排名何时反映真实的能力差异，何时反映评估伪影。

sentences.en: We introduce a framework for measuring the latent landscape in AI benchmark ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个用于衡量 AI 基准生态中潜在景观的框架。

sentences.en: Applying Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and Generalizability Theory to 4,000+ models from the Open LLM Leaderboard, we decompose sources of ranking variance and establish:  (1) structures assumed in current reporting practice underestimate the strength of relationships between benchmarks; (2) evidence of local dependence among leaderboard items, undermining uses of benchmarks as measurement instruments under current scoring systems;  (3) contributor metadata explains more rank-relevant variance ($\approx9\%$) than architecture or deployment categories in this context; (4) a manifest-score ``scaling law'' slope has low reliability ($R_{\beta}=0.53$); by contrast, the latent general-factor size slope is highly stable across ecosystem controls ($R_g=0.97$).
sentences.zh: 应用验证性因素分析（CFA）和概化理论于来自开放 LLM 排行榜的 4000 多个模型，我们分解了排名方差的来源并确立了：（1）当前报告实践中所假设的结构低估了基准之间关系的强度；（2）排行榜条目之间存在局部依赖的证据，削弱了在现行评分系统下将基准用作测量工具的用途；（3）在此情境下，贡献者元数据比架构或部署类别解释了更多与排名相关的方差（约 9\%）；（4）显式分数的“扩展定律”斜率具有较低的可靠性（$R_{\beta}=0.53$）；相比之下，潜在一般因子规模的斜率在生态系统控制变量下高度稳定（$R_g=0.97$）。

sentences.en: We are able to provide unique insights into benchmark dynamics, such as which benchmarks are a function of LLM size and which can be oppositely impacted by post-training practices.
sentences.zh: 我们能够提供对基准动态的独特洞见，例如哪些基准是 LLM 规模的函数，哪些基准可能受到训练后实践的相反影响。

sentences.en: We provide actionable diagnostics to determine how benchmark rankings can be trusted and how benchmark design can be improved.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了可操作的诊断方法，以确定基准排名在何种程度上可以信赖，以及如何改进基准设计。

title_en: AI Engram: In Search of Memory Traces in Artificial Intelligence
title_zh: AI 记忆痕迹：探寻人工智能中的记忆印迹

sentences.en: Memory formation is fundamental to intelligence, yet whether deep neural networks preserve identifiable memory traces—analogous to biological memory units—remains an open question.
sentences.zh: 记忆形成是智力的基础，然而深度神经网络是否保留了可识别的记忆痕迹——类似于生物记忆单元——仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: This work introduces a geometric framework to identify such "AI engrams," by formalizing the neuroscientific criteria of specificity, reactivation, sufficiency, and necessity into a constrained inverse problem.
sentences.zh: 本工作引入一个几何框架来识别此类“AI 记忆痕迹”，通过将神经科学的特异性、重激活、充分性和必要性标准形式化为一个受约束的逆问题。

sentences.en: We derive a closed-form estimator that isolates individual memory traces from globally entangled parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出一个闭式估计器，用于从全局纠缠的参数中分离出单个记忆痕迹。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis reveals that this biologically-derived solution corresponds to a natural gradient update on the parameter manifold.
sentences.zh: 理论分析揭示，这一源于生物学的解对应于参数流形上的自然梯度更新。

sentences.en: AI engrams enable surgical manipulation of learned knowledge: any subset of memories can be composed or erased through linear arithmetic, without iterative optimization.
sentences.zh: AI 记忆痕迹使得对所学知识进行外科手术式的操纵成为可能：任何记忆子集都可以通过线性算术进行组合或擦除，而无需迭代优化。

sentences.en: Experiments ranging from simple MLPs to LLMs demonstrate the causal validity and substantial scalability of AI engrams.
sentences.zh: 从简单 MLP 到 LLM 的实验证明了 AI 记忆痕迹的因果有效性和显著的可扩展性。

sentences.en: Together, these results bridge theories of biological memory and artificial representation learning, offering geometric insight into how deep networks simultaneously support functional specificity within distributed storage.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这些结果在生物记忆理论和人工表示学习之间架起了一座桥梁，为深度网络如何在分布式存储中同时支持功能特异性提供了几何层面的洞见。

title_en: AI4SLT: Empirical Processes in Lean 4 for Formal Statistical Learning Theory
title_zh: AI4SLT：在 Lean 4 中构建经验过程以形式化统计学习理论

sentences.en: We present the first comprehensive Lean 4 formalization of statistical learning theory (SLT) grounded in empirical process theory.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了首个以经验过程理论为基础的全面的统计学习理论（SLT）Lean 4 形式化。

sentences.en: Our end-to-end formal infrastructure implement the missing contents in latest Lean library, including a complete development of Gaussian Lipschitz concentration, Dudley’s entropy integral theorem for sub-Gaussian processes, and an application to least-squares (sparse) regression with a sharp rate.
sentences.zh: 我们的端到端形式化基础设施实现了最新 Lean 库中缺失的内容，包括高斯 Lipschitz 集中的完整展开、次高斯过程的 Dudley 熵积分定理，以及一个以锐利速率应用于最小二乘（稀疏）回归的例子。

sentences.en: The project was carried out using a human-AI collaborative workflow, in which humans design proof strategies and AI agents execute tactical proof construction, leading to the human-verified Lean 4 toolbox for SLT.
sentences.zh: 该项目采用人-AI 协作工作流完成，其中人类设计证明策略，AI 智能体执行战术性的证明构建，从而产生了经人工验证的 SLT Lean 4 工具箱。

sentences.en: Beyond implementation, the formalization process exposes and resolves implicit assumptions and missing details in standard SLT textbooks, enforcing a granular, line-by-line understanding of the theory.
sentences.zh: 除了实现之外，形式化过程还暴露并解决了标准 SLT 教科书中隐含的假设和缺失的细节，强制对该理论进行细粒度的、逐行的理解。

sentences.en: This work establishes a reusable formal foundation and opens the door for future developments in machine learning theory.
sentences.zh: 本工作建立了一个可复用的形式化基础，并为机器学习理论的未来发展打开了大门。

sentences.en: The code is provided in https://github.com/YuanheZ/lean-stat-learning-theory.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/YuanheZ/lean-stat-learning-theory 获取。

title_en: AICrypto: Evaluating Cryptography Capabilities of Large Language Models
title_zh: AICrypto：评估大语言模型的密码学能力

sentences.en: We build \textbf{AICrypto}, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the cryptography capabilities of large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 我们构建了 **AICrypto**，一个旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）密码学能力的全面基准。

sentences.en: The benchmark comprises 135 multiple-choice questions, 150 capture-the-flag challenges, and 30 proof problems, covering a broad range of skills from knowledge memorization to vulnerability exploitation and formal reasoning.
sentences.zh: 该基准包含 135 个多项选择题、150 个夺旗挑战和 30 个证明问题，涵盖从知识记忆到漏洞利用和形式推理的广泛技能。

sentences.en: All tasks are carefully reviewed or constructed by cryptography experts to improve correctness and rigor.
sentences.zh: 所有任务都经过密码学专家的仔细审查或构建，以提高正确性和严谨性。

sentences.en: For each proof problem, we provide detailed scoring rubrics and reference solutions that enable automated grading, achieving high correlation with human expert evaluations.
sentences.zh: 对于每个证明问题，我们提供了详细的评分细则和参考答案，从而支持自动化评分，并与人类专家评估实现了高度相关。

sentences.en: We introduce strong human expert performance baselines for comparison across all task types.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了强有力的人类专家性能基线，以在所有任务类型中进行比较。

sentences.en: Our evaluation of 17 leading LLMs reveals that state-of-the-art models match or even surpass human experts in memorizing cryptographic concepts, exploiting common vulnerabilities, and routine proofs.
sentences.zh: 我们对 17 个领先 LLM 的评估表明，最先进的模型在记忆密码学概念、利用常见漏洞和常规证明方面能够与人类专家相当甚至超越。

sentences.en: However, our analysis reveals that they still lack a deep understanding of abstract mathematical concepts and struggle with tasks that require multi-step reasoning and dynamic analysis.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的分析揭示，它们仍然缺乏对抽象数学概念的深入理解，并且在需要多步推理和动态分析的任务上存在困难。

sentences.en: We hope this work could provide insights for future research on LLMs in cryptographic applications.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这项工作能够为 LLM 在密码学应用中的未来研究提供洞见。

sentences.en: Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/wangyu-ovo/aicrypto-agent.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/wangyu-ovo/aicrypto-agent 获取。

title_en: AIR-VLA: Vision-Language-Action Systems for Aerial Manipulation
title_zh: AIR-VLA：用于空中操作的视觉–语言–动作系统

sentences.en: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable success in ground-based embodied intelligence, their application to Aerial Manipulation Systems (AMS) remains a largely unexplored frontier.
sentences.zh: 虽然视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在地面具身智能方面取得了显著成功，但它们在空中操纵系统（AMS）中的应用仍然是一个在很大程度上尚未探索的前沿领域。

sentences.en: The inherent characteristics of AMS, including floating-base dynamics, strong coupling between the UAV and the manipulator, and the multi-step, long-horizon nature of operational tasks, pose severe challenges to existing VLA paradigms designed for static or 2D mobile bases.
sentences.zh: AMS 的固有特性，包括浮动基座动力学、无人机与机械臂之间的强耦合，以及操作任务的多步、长时域特性，对为静态或 2D 移动基座设计的现有 VLA 范式构成了严峻的挑战。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose AIR-VLA, the first VLA benchmark specifically tailored for aerial manipulation.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出 AIR-VLA，第一个专门为空中操纵量身定制的 VLA 基准。

sentences.en: We construct a physics-based simulation environment and release a high-quality multimodal dataset comprising 3000 manually teleoperated demonstrations, covering base manipulation, object & spatial understanding, semantic reasoning, and long-horizon planning.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个基于物理的仿真环境，并发布了一个高质量的多模态数据集，包含 3000 条人工遥控操作示范，涵盖基座操纵、物体与空间理解、语义推理以及长时域规划。

sentences.en: Leveraging this platform, we systematically evaluate mainstream VLA models and state-of-the-art VLM models.
sentences.zh: 利用这一平台，我们系统地评估了主流 VLA 模型和最先进的 VLM 模型。

sentences.en: Our experiments not only validate the feasibility of transferring VLA paradigms to aerial systems but also, through multi-dimensional metrics tailored to aerial tasks, reveal the capabilities and boundaries of current models regarding UAV mobility, manipulator control, and high-level planning.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验不仅验证了将 VLA 范式迁移到空中系统的可行性，还通过针对空中任务定制的多维指标，揭示了当前模型在无人机机动性、机械臂控制和高层规划方面的能力与边界。

sentences.en: AIR-VLA establishes a standardized testbed and data foundation for future research in general-purpose aerial robotics.
sentences.zh: AIR-VLA 为通用空中机器人技术的未来研究建立了一个标准化的测试平台和数据基础。

sentences.en: The resource of AIR-VLA will be available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AIR-VLA-dataset-B5CC/.
sentences.zh: AIR-VLA 的资源将在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AIR-VLA-dataset-B5CC/ 提供。

title_en: AIR: Improving Agent Safety through Incident Response
title_zh: AIR：通过事件响应提升智能体安全性

sentences.en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in practice across a wide range of autonomous applications.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正随着实践的深入而被广泛部署到各类自主应用中。

sentences.en: Yet current safety mechanisms for LLM agents focus almost exclusively on preventing failures in advance, providing limited capabilities for responding to, containing, or recovering from incidents after they inevitably  arise.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前面向 LLM 智能体的安全机制几乎只专注于事先防止失败，在事件不可避免发生后，提供响应、遏制或恢复的能力十分有限。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce AIR, the first incident response framework for LLM agent systems.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入 AIR，第一个面向 LLM 智能体系统的事件响应框架。

sentences.en: AIR defines a domain-specific language for managing the incident response lifecycle autonomously in LLM agent systems, and integrates it into the agent's execution loop to (1) detect incidents via semantic checks grounded in the current environment state and recent context, (2) guide the agent to execute containment and recovery actions via its tools, and (3) synthesize guardrail rules during eradication to block similar incidents in future executions.
sentences.zh: AIR 定义了一种用于在 LLM 智能体系统中自主管理事件响应生命周期的领域特定语言，并将其集成到智能体的执行循环中，以（1）通过基于当前环境状态和近期上下文的语义检查来检测事件，（2）引导智能体通过其工具执行遏制和恢复操作，以及（3）在根除阶段综合护栏规则，以阻止类似事件在未来的执行中再次发生。

sentences.en: We evaluate AIR on three representative agent types.
sentences.zh: 我们在三种具有代表性的智能体类型上评估了 AIR。

sentences.en: Results show that AIR achieves detection, remediation, and eradication success rates all exceeding 90%.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，AIR 在检测、修复和根除方面的成功率均超过 90%。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments further confirm the necessity of AIR's key design components, show the timeliness and moderate overhead of AIR, and demonstrate that LLM-generated rules can approach the effectiveness of developer-authored rules across domains.
sentences.zh: 大量实验进一步证实了 AIR 关键设计组件的必要性，展示了 AIR 的及时性和适度的开销，并证明 LLM 生成的规则在跨领域的护栏有效性上可以接近开发人员编写的规则。

sentences.en: These results show that incident response is both feasible and essential as a first-class mechanism for improving agent safety.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，作为提升智能体安全性的一等机制，事件响应既可行又必不可少。

title_en: AIR: Post-training Data Selection for Reasoning via Attention Head Influence
title_zh: AIR：通过注意力头影响力选择用于推理的后训练数据

sentences.en: LLMs achieve remarkable multi-step reasoning capabilities, yet effectively transferring these skills via post-training distillation remains challenging.
sentences.zh: LLM 实现了非凡的多步推理能力，然而通过训练后蒸馏有效地迁移这些技能仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Existing data selection methods, ranging from manual curation to heuristics based on length, entropy, or overall loss, fail to capture the causal importance of individual reasoning steps, limiting distillation efficiency.
sentences.zh: 现有的数据选择方法，从手工策展到基于长度、熵或整体损失的启发式方法，都无法捕捉单个推理步骤的因果重要性，从而限制了蒸馏效率。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Attention Influence for Reasoning (AIR), a principled, unsupervised and training-free framework that leverages mechanistic insights of the retrieval head to select high-value post-training data.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出用于推理的注意力影响力（Attention Influence for Reasoning，AIR），一个基于原理、无监督且免训练的框架，它利用检索头的机理洞见来选择高价值的训练后数据。

sentences.en: AIR first identifies reasoning-critical attention heads of an off-the-shelf model, then constructs a weakened reference model with disabled head influence, and finally quantifies the resulting loss divergence as the Attention Influence Score.
sentences.zh: AIR 首先识别现成模型中推理关键的注意力头，然后构建一个禁用这些头影响力的弱化参考模型，最后将由此产生的损失差异量化为注意力影响力得分。

sentences.en: This score enables fine-grained assessment at both the step and sample levels, supporting step-level weighted fine-tuning and global sample selection.
sentences.zh: 这一得分能够在步骤和样本两个层面实现细粒度的评估，支持步骤级加权微调和全局样本选择。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks show that AIR consistently improves reasoning accuracy, surpassing heuristic baselines and effectively isolating the most critical steps and samples.
sentences.zh: 在多个推理基准上的实验表明，AIR 一致地提升了推理准确率，超越了启发式基线，并有效地隔离出最关键的步骤和样本。

sentences.en: Our work establishes a mechanism-driven, data-efficient approach for reasoning distillation in LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作为 LLM 中的推理蒸馏建立了一种机制驱动、数据高效的方法。

title_en: Aitchison Embeddings for Learning Compositional Graph Representations
title_zh: 用于学习成分图表征的 Aitchison 嵌入

sentences.en: Representation learning is central to graph machine learning, powering tasks such as link prediction and node classification.
sentences.zh: 表示学习是图机器学习的核心，支撑着链接预测和节点分类等任务。

sentences.en: However, most graph embeddings are hard to interpret, offering limited insight into how learned features relate to graph structure.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数图嵌入难以解释，其所学特征与图结构之间的关系提供的洞见有限。

sentences.en: Many networks naturally admit a role-mixture view, where nodes are best described as mixtures over latent archetypal factors.
sentences.zh: 许多网络天然容许一种角色混合的视角，其中节点被最好地描述为对潜在原型因素的混合。

sentences.en: Motivated by this structure, we propose a compositional graph embedding framework grounded in Aitchison geometry, the canonical geometry for comparing mixtures.
sentences.zh: 受这一结构的启发，我们提出一个基于 Aitchison 几何的组合式图嵌入框架，Aitchison 几何是比较混合物的规范几何。

sentences.en: Nodes are represented as simplex-valued compositions and embedded via isometric log-ratio (ILR) coordinates, which preserve Aitchison distances while enabling unconstrained optimization in Euclidean space.
sentences.zh: 节点被表示为单纯形值的组合，并通过等距对数比（ILR）坐标进行嵌入，这既保持了 Aitchison 距离，又允许在欧几里得空间中进行无约束优化。

sentences.en: This yields intrinsically interpretable embeddings whose geometry reflects relative trade-offs among archetypes and supports coherent behavior under component restriction; we consider both fixed and learnable ILR bases.
sentences.zh: 这产生了本质上可解释的嵌入，其几何反映了原型之间的相对权衡，并在分量限制下支持连贯的行为；我们同时考虑固定的和可学习的 ILR 基。

sentences.en: Across node classification and link prediction, our method achieves competitive performance with strong baselines while providing explainability by construction rather than post hoc.
sentences.zh: 在节点分类和链接预测上，我们的方法在实现与强基线相当的性能的同时，通过构造而非事后方式提供可解释性。

sentences.en: Finally, subcompositional coherence enables principled component restriction: removing and renormalizing subsets preserves a well-defined geometry, which we exploit via subcompositional dimensionality removal to probe how archetype groups influence representations and predictions.
sentences.zh: 最后，子组合连贯性实现了原则性的分量限制：移除并重新归一化子集能够保持良定义的几何，我们利用这一点，通过子组合维数移除来探查原型组如何影响表示和预测。

title_en: ALAS: Additive Learnable Alpha-Stable Kernels for Flexible Bayesian Optimization
title_zh: ALAS：用于灵活贝叶斯优化的可加可学习 α 稳定核

sentences.en: Bayesian Optimization is widely used for expensive black-box optimization, yet its success often depends on choosing a kernel that matches the objective’s unknown structure.
sentences.zh: 贝叶斯优化被广泛用于代价高昂的黑盒优化，然而其成功往往取决于选择一个与目标未知结构相匹配的核。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose ALAS, a flexible Gaussian Process kernel family built from symmetric $\alpha$-stable spectral components.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 ALAS，一个由对称的 $\alpha$-稳定谱分量构建的灵活高斯过程核族。

sentences.en: By learning the stability parameter $\alpha$, ALAS adapts its effective smoothness from data, capturing both smooth trends and sharp irregularities.
sentences.zh: 通过学习稳定性参数 $\alpha$，ALAS 从数据中自适应其有效平滑度，既能捕捉平滑趋势，也能捕捉锐利的不规则性。

sentences.en: We present two parameterizations: ALAS, a single stationary component with joint spectral modulation, and ALAS-Sep, a separable variant that learns dimension-wise tail behavior to improve robustness on approximately decomposable objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们提出两种参数化：ALAS，一个具有联合谱调制的单一平稳分量；以及 ALAS-Sep，一个可分离的变体，它学习逐维的尾部行为，以提升在近似可分解目标上的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Experiments on standard benchmarks and real-world surrogates demonstrate strong and robust performance across diverse settings.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准和真实世界代理上的实验表明，该框架在多样化的设置中展现出强劲且鲁棒的性能表现。

title_en: Alethia: a Foundational Encoder for Voice Deepfakes
title_zh: Alethia：面向语音深度伪造的基础编码器

sentences.en: Existing voice deepfake detection and localization models rely heavily on representations extracted from speech foundation models (SFMs).
sentences.zh: 现有的语音深度伪造检测和定位模型，在很大程度上依赖于从语音基础模型（SFM）中提取的表示。

sentences.en: However, downstream finetuning has now reached a state of diminishing returns.
sentences.zh: 然而，下游微调现在已达到收益递减的状态。

sentences.en: In this paper, we shift the focus to pretraining and propose a novel recipe that combines *bottleneck masked embedding prediction with flow-matching based spectrogram reconstruction*.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将焦点转向预训练，并提出一个新颖的方案，将*瓶颈掩码嵌入预测与基于流匹配的声谱图重建*相结合。

sentences.en: The outcome, *Alethia*, is the first foundational audio encoder for various voice deepfake detection and localization tasks.
sentences.zh: 其成果 *Alethia* 是首个面向各种语音深度伪造检测和定位任务的基础音频编码器。

sentences.en: We evaluate on 5 different tasks with 56 benchmark datasets, and note *Alethia* significantly outperforms state-of-the-art SFMs with superior robustness to real-world perturbations and zero-shot generalization to unseen domains (e.g., singing deepfakes).
sentences.zh: 我们在包含 56 个基准数据集的 5 个不同任务上进行了评估，并指出 *Alethia* 显著优于最先进的 SFM，对真实世界扰动具有优越的鲁棒性，并能零样本泛化到未见过的领域（例如，歌唱深度伪造）。

sentences.en: We also demonstrate the limitation of discrete targets in masked token prediction, and show the importance of *continuous embedding* prediction and *generative pretraining* for capturing deepfake artifacts.
sentences.zh: 我们还展示了离散目标在掩码 token 预测中的局限性，并证明了*连续嵌入*预测和*生成式预训练*对于捕捉深度伪造伪影的重要性。

title_en: Algorithmic Recourse of In-Context Learning for Tabular Data
title_zh: 表格数据上下文学习中的算法追索

sentences.en: As predictive models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as credit approval, there is a growing need for post-hoc methods that provide recourse to affected individuals.
sentences.zh: 随着预测模型在信贷审批等高风险场景中被日益部署，对为受影响个体提供补救的事后方法的需求也在不断增长。

sentences.en: Many such models operate on tabular data, where features correspond to real-world attributes.
sentences.zh: 许多此类模型处理的是表格数据，其中特征对应于现实世界的属性。

sentences.en: Recently, in-context learning (ICL) has enabled large language models to perform tabular prediction by conditioning on labeled examples at inference time, without explicit training.
sentences.zh: 近来，上下文学习（ICL）使大语言模型能够在推理时通过条件化于带标签的示例来进行表格预测，而无需显式训练。

sentences.en: However, algorithmic recourse for tabular decision-making under ICL remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，ICL 下表格决策的算法补救在很大程度上尚未被探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we present the first study of algorithmic recourse for tabular data under ICL.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了对 ICL 下表格数据算法补救的首次研究。

sentences.en: We carry out a theoretical analysis, showing that recourse remains well-defined and bounded, and we characterize how recourse converges toward classical solutions as the context size increases.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了理论分析，表明补救仍然良定义且有界，并刻画了随着上下文大小增加，补救如何向经典解收敛。

sentences.en: In practice, we propose a novel zeroth-order recourse framework, Adaptive Subspace Recourse for In-Context Learning (ASR-ICL), that efficiently generates actionable and sparse recourse for black-box ICL models.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，我们提出一个新颖的零阶补救框架——面向上下文学习的自适应子空间补救（ASR-ICL），它能够为黑盒 ICL 模型高效地生成可操作且稀疏的补救。

sentences.en: The proposed framework naturally extends to multi-class tabular tasks.
sentences.zh: 所提出的框架自然地扩展到多类表格任务。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple real-world datasets and models demonstrate that ASR-ICL achieves recourse quality comparable to existing methods with fewer queries and empirically confirm the predicted convergence behavior, supporting our theoretical analysis.
sentences.zh: 在多个真实世界数据集和模型上的实验表明，ASR-ICL 以更少的查询实现了与现有方法相当的补救质量，并实证确认了预测的收敛行为，支持了我们的理论分析。

title_en: AlgoTrace: Algorithmic Primitives and Compositional Geometry of Reasoning in Language Models
title_zh: AlgoTrace：语言模型推理的算法原语与组合几何结构

sentences.en: How do inference time and latent computations enable large language models (LLMs) to solve multi-step reasoning problems?
sentences.zh: 推理时间和潜在计算如何使大语言模型（LLM）能够解决多步推理问题？

sentences.en: We introduce AlgoTrace, a framework for tracing and steering algorithmic operations in the model latent space for multi-step reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 AlgoTrace，一个用于在多步推理中追踪和引导模型潜在空间中算法操作的框架。

sentences.en: We operationalize primitives by clustering latent activations of the model when solving four benchmarks: Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP), 3SAT, AIME, and Graph Navigation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过对模型在求解四个基准——旅行商问题（TSP）、3SAT、AIME 和图导航——时的潜在激活进行聚类，来实现算法原语的操作化。

sentences.en: We annotate the clusters using their corresponding tokens in the reasoning trace.
sentences.zh: 我们使用推理轨迹中对应的 token 来标注这些聚类。

sentences.en: We then apply function vector methods to extract primitive vectors as reusable compositional building blocks of reasoning.
sentences.zh: 然后我们应用函数向量方法，将原语向量提取为可复用的推理组合构建模块。

sentences.en: We find that a) injecting a primitive vector into models (Phi, Qwen, Llama) elicits the associated algorithmic operation in the reasoning trace, b) injecting primitives can steer behavior across tasks, c) primitive vectors can be composed through algebraic operations, revealing a geometric logic in activation space, and d) a fine-tuned model exhibits improved composition of primitives (Phi-4-Reasoning vs. Phi-4).
sentences.zh: 我们发现：a）向模型（Phi、Qwen、Llama）注入原语向量会引发推理轨迹中相应的算法操作；b）注入原语可以跨任务引导行为；c）原语向量可以通过代数运算进行组合，揭示出激活空间中的几何逻辑；以及 d）微调后的模型表现出改进的原语组合能力（Phi-4-Reasoning 对比 Phi-4）。

sentences.en: These findings demonstrate that LLM reasoning can be understood as a walk through algorithmic primitives in the latent space governed by compositional geometry.
sentences.zh: 这些发现表明，LLM 推理可以被理解为在潜在空间中、由组合几何所支配的对算法原语的行走。

sentences.en: These primitives transfer across tasks, and reasoning finetuning strengthens algorithmic generalization and composition across domains.
sentences.zh: 这些原语可跨任务迁移，而推理微调则增强了跨领域的算法泛化和组合能力。

title_en: AlgoVeri: An Aligned Benchmark for Verified Code Generation on Classical Algorithms
title_zh: AlgoVeri：面向经典算法可验证代码生成的对齐基准

sentences.en: Vericoding refers to the generation of formally verified code from rigorous specifications.
sentences.zh: 验证编码（Vericoding）指的是根据形式化规范生成经过形式验证的代码。

sentences.en: Recent AI models show promise in vericoding, but a unified methodology for cross-paradigm evaluation is lacking.
sentences.zh: 最近的 AI 模型在验证编码方面显示出潜力，但缺乏一种用于跨范式评估的统一方法论。

sentences.en: Existing benchmarks test only an individual language/tool (e.g., Dafny, Verus, and Lean) and each covers very different tasks, so the performance numbers are not directly comparable.
sentences.zh: 现有的基准只测试单个语言/工具（例如，Dafny、Verus 和 Lean），并且每个基准覆盖的任务大相径庭，因此性能数字不具有直接可比性。

sentences.en: We address this gap with AlgoVeri, a benchmark that evaluates vericoding of $77$ classical algorithms in each of Dafny, Verus, and Lean.
sentences.zh: 我们通过 AlgoVeri 来弥合这一差距，这是一个评估 $77$ 个经典算法在 Dafny、Verus 和 Lean 中各自实现验证编码的基准。

sentences.en: By enforcing identical functional contracts, AlgoVeri reveals critical capability gaps in current models.
sentences.zh: 通过强制采用相同的功能契约，AlgoVeri 揭示了当前模型中的关键能力差距。

sentences.en: While frontier models achieve tractable success in Dafny ($40.3$\% for Gemini-3 Flash), where high-level abstractions and SMT automation simplify the workflow, performance collapses under the systems-level memory constraints of Verus ($24.7$\%) and the explicit proof construction required by Lean (7.8\%).
sentences.zh: 虽然前沿模型在 Dafny 中取得了可处理的成功（Gemini-3 Flash 为 $40.3$\%），在其中高层抽象和 SMT 自动化简化了工作流，但在 Verus 的系统级内存约束下（$24.7$\%）以及 Lean 所需的显式证明构建下（7.8\%），性能崩溃了。

sentences.en: Beyond aggregate metrics, we uncover a sharp divergence in test-time compute dynamics: Gemini-3 effectively utilizes iterative repair to boost performance (e.g., tripling pass rates in Dafny), whereas GPT-OSS saturates early.
sentences.zh: 除了聚合指标之外，我们还发现了测试时计算动态的显著分歧：Gemini-3 有效利用迭代修复来提升性能（例如，在 Dafny 中将通过率提高了两倍），而 GPT-OSS 则过早饱和。

sentences.en: Finally, our error analysis shows that language design affects the refinement trajectory: while Dafny allows models to focus on logical correctness, Verus and Lean trap models in persistent syntactic and semantic barriers.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们的错误分析表明，语言设计会影响精化轨迹：虽然 Dafny 允许模型专注于逻辑正确性，但 Verus 和 Lean 将模型困在持续存在的语法和语义障碍中。

title_en: AlienLM: Alienization of Language for API-Boundary Privacy in Black-Box LLMs
title_zh: AlienLM：通过语言异化实现黑盒大语言模型 API 边界上的隐私保护

sentences.en: Modern LLMs are increasingly accessed via black-box APIs, requiring users to transmit sensitive prompts, outputs, and fine-tuning data to external providers, creating a critical privacy risk at the API boundary.
sentences.zh: 现代 LLM 越来越多地通过黑盒 API 访问，这要求用户将敏感的提示、输出和微调数据传输给外部提供者，从而在 API 边界产生了严重的隐私风险。

sentences.en: We introduce AlienLM, a deployable API-only privacy layer that protects text by translating it into an Alien Language via a vocabulary-scale bijection, enabling lossless recovery on the client side.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 AlienLM，一个可部署的仅限 API 的隐私层，它通过词表规模的映射将文本翻译成一种外星语言（Alien Language），从而在客户端实现无损恢复。

sentences.en: Using only standard fine-tuning APIs, Alien Adaptation Training (AAT) adapts target models to operate directly on alienized inputs.
sentences.zh: 仅使用标准的微调 API，外星适配训练（Alien Adaptation Training，AAT）使目标模型能够直接对陌生化输入进行操作。

sentences.en: Across four LLM backbones and seven benchmarks, AlienLM retains over 81% of plaintext-oracle performance on average, substantially outperforming random-bijection and character-level baselines.
sentences.zh: 在四个 LLM 骨干和七个基准上，AlienLM 平均保留了超过 81% 的明文预言机性能，显著优于随机双射和字符级基线。

sentences.en: Under adversaries with access to model weights, corpus statistics, and learning-based inverse translation, recovery attacks reconstruct fewer than 0.22% of alienized tokens.
sentences.zh: 在面对能够访问模型权重、语料统计信息和基于学习的逆向翻译的对手时，恢复攻击重构出的陌生化 token 不足 0.22%。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate a practical pathway for privacy-preserving LLM deployment under API-only access, substantially reducing plaintext exposure while maintaining task performance.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，在仅限 API 访问下进行隐私保护的 LLM 部署是一条实用的路径，它大幅减少了明文暴露，同时保持了任务性能。

title_en: Align Forward, Adapt Backward: Closing the Discretization Gap in Logic Gate Networks
title_zh: 前向对齐，反向适应：弥合逻辑门网络中的离散化差距

sentences.en: In neural network models, soft mixtures of fixed candidate components (e.g., logic gates and sub-networks) are often used during training for stable optimization, while hard selection is typically used at inference.
sentences.zh: 在神经网络模型中，固定的候选组件（例如，逻辑门和子网络）的软混合常常在训练期间用于稳定的优化，而硬选择通常在推断时使用。

sentences.en: This raises questions about training-inference mismatch.
sentences.zh: 这引发了关于训练-推断不匹配的问题。

sentences.en: We analyze this gap by separating forward-pass computation (hard selection vs. soft mixture) from stochasticity (with vs. without Gumbel noise).
sentences.zh: 我们通过将前向传播计算（硬选择对比软混合）与随机性（有或无 Gumbel 噪声）相分离来分析这一差距。

sentences.en: Using logic gate networks as a testbed, we observe distinct behaviors across four methods: Hard-ST achieves zero selection gap by construction;
sentences.zh: 以逻辑门网络作为测试平台，我们观察到四种方法的不同行为：Hard-ST 通过构造实现了零选择差距；

sentences.en: Gumbel-ST achieves near-zero gap when training succeeds but suffers accuracy collapse at low temperatures;
sentences.zh: Gumbel-ST 在训练成功时实现接近零的差距，但在低温度下遭受准确率崩溃；

sentences.en: Soft-Mix achieves small gap only at low temperature via weight concentration; and Soft-Gumbel exhibits large gaps despite Gumbel noise, confirming that noise alone does not reduce the gap.
sentences.zh: Soft-Mix 仅在低温度下通过权重集中实现小差距；而 Soft-Gumbel 尽管有 Gumbel 噪声，仍表现出大差距，证实了仅靠噪声并不会减小差距。

sentences.en: We propose CAGE (Confidence-Adaptive Gradient Estimation) to maintain gradient flow while preserving forward alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CAGE（置信度自适应梯度估计）来在保持前向对齐的同时维持梯度流。

sentences.en: On logic gate networks, Hard-ST and Gumbel-ST with CAGE both achieve over 98\% accuracy on MNIST and ${\sim}58\%$ on CIFAR-10;
sentences.zh: 在逻辑门网络上，使用 CAGE 的 Hard-ST 和 Gumbel-ST 在 MNIST 上都实现了超过 98\% 的准确率，在 CIFAR-10 上实现了约 58\% 的准确率；

sentences.en: Hard-ST with CAGE further maintains zero selection gap across all temperatures by construction, while Gumbel-ST without CAGE suffers a ${\sim}47$-point accuracy collapse.
sentences.zh: 使用 CAGE 的 Hard-ST 还通过构造在所有温度下保持零选择差距，而没有 CAGE 的 Gumbel-ST 则遭受了约 47 个百分点的准确率崩溃。

title_en: Align Your Trajectory Tangent: Training Better Consistency Models via Manifold-Aligned Tangents
title_zh: 对齐轨迹切向量：通过流形对齐的切向量训练更好的一致性模型

sentences.en: With diffusion and flow matching models achieving state-of-the-art generating performance, the interest of the community now turned to reducing the inference time without sacrificing sample quality.
sentences.zh: 随着扩散模型和流匹配模型实现了最先进的生成性能，社区的关注点现在转向在不牺牲样本质量的情况下减少推断时间。

sentences.en: Consistency Models (CMs), which are trained to be consistent on diffusion or probability flow ordinary differential equation (PF-ODE) trajectories, enable one or two-step flow or diffusion sampling.
sentences.zh: 一致性模型（CM）被训练为在扩散或概率流常微分方程（PF-ODE）轨迹上保持一致，从而能够实现一步或两步的流或扩散采样。

sentences.en: However, CMs typically require prolonged training with large batch sizes to obtain competitive sample quality.
sentences.zh: 然而，CM 通常需要长时间的大批量训练才能获得有竞争力的样本质量。

sentences.en: In this paper, we examine the training dynamics of CMs near convergence and discover that CM trajectory tangents -- CM output update directions -- are quite oscillatory, in the sense that they move parallel to the data manifold, not towards the manifold.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们考察了 CM 在收敛附近的训练动态，并发现 CM 的轨迹切线——即 CM 输出更新方向——相当振荡，在某种意义上它们平行于数据流形移动，而非朝向流形。

sentences.en: To mitigate oscillatory trajectory tangents, we propose a new loss function, called the {\em manifold feature distance (MFD)}, which provides manifold-aligned trajectory tangents that point toward the data manifold.
sentences.zh: 为了缓解振荡的轨迹切线，我们提出一个新损失函数，称为流形特征距离（manifold feature distance，MFD），它提供指向数据流形方向的流形对齐轨迹切线。

sentences.en: Consequently, our method -- dubbed  {\em Align Your Trajectory Tangent (AYT)} -- can accelerate CM training by orders of magnitude and even out-perform the learned perceptual image patch similarity metric (LPIPS).
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的方法——被称为对齐你的轨迹切线（Align Your Trajectory Tangent，AYT）——能够将 CM 训练加速数个数量级，甚至超越学习到的感知图像块相似度度量（LPIPS）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we find that our loss enables training with extremely small batch sizes without compromising sample quality.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们发现我们的损失能够在样本质量不受损的情况下，以极小的批量进行训练。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/1202kbs/AYT}
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/1202kbs/AYT 获取。

title_en: AlignedNorm: Prompting Vision–Language Models via Coupled Prompt Field
title_zh: AlignedNorm：通过耦合提示场对视觉语言模型进行提示

sentences.en: Prompt learning for vision-language models (VLMs) primarily follows end-to-end or decoupled routes to balance base and new task performance, but suffers a fundamental bottleneck: sample-wise optimization within task-specific feature spaces traps models in local optima, hindering global optimality.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）的提示学习主要遵循端到端或解耦的路线，以平衡基类和新类任务性能，但它遭受一个根本性的瓶颈：在任务特定的特征空间内进行样本级优化，会使模型陷入局部最优，妨碍全局最优性。

sentences.en: To address this, we identify a key insight that VLMs can be prompted within a Coupled Prompt Field-a shared space where base and new tasks are mutually constrained-and present AlignedNorm, which enforces the field coupling.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们识别出一个关键洞见，即 VLM 可以在耦合提示域（Coupled Prompt Field）——一个基类和新任务相互约束的共享空间——内被提示，并提出 AlignedNorm 来实施这种域耦合。

sentences.en: By dynamically aligning the norms of prompts to VLMs' native scale, our method enables joint optimization of both tasks.
sentences.zh: 通过动态地将提示的范数对齐到 VLM 的原生尺度，我们的方法使得两个任务的联合优化成为可能。

sentences.en: Without complex designs, our method matches leading decoupled approaches on 15 datasets across 4 experimental settings, offering both a new perspective and a practical solution to the local-optima dilemma in prompt learning.
sentences.zh: 在不采用复杂设计的情况下，我们的方法在 4 种实验设置的 15 个数据集上匹配了领先的解耦方法，为提示学习中的局部最优困境提供了新的视角和实用的解决方案。

title_en: Aligning Tree-Search Policies with Fixed Token Budgets in Test-Time Scaling of LLMs
title_zh: 在大语言模型测试时扩展中将树搜索策略与固定词元预算对齐

sentences.en: Tree-search decoding is an effective form of test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs), but real-world deployment often imposes a fixed per-query token budget that varies across settings.
sentences.zh: 树搜索解码是大语言模型（LLM）测试时扩展的一种有效形式，但真实世界的部署往往施加一个固定的、随设置而变化的每次查询 token 预算。

sentences.en: Existing tree-search policies are largely budget-agnostic, treating the budget merely as a termination condition, thereby risking late-stage over-branching or premature termination.
sentences.zh: 现有的树搜索策略在很大程度上与预算无关，它们仅将预算视为终止条件，从而面临后期过度分叉或过早终止的风险。

sentences.en: We propose Budget-Guided MCTS (BG-MCTS), a tree-search decoding algorithm that aligns its search policy with the remaining token budget: it starts with broad exploration, then prioritizes refinement and answer completion as the remaining budget decreases while reducing late-stage branching from shallow nodes.
sentences.zh: 我们提出预算引导的 MCTS（BG-MCTS），一个将其搜索策略与剩余 token 预算对齐的树搜索解码算法：它以广泛的探索开始，然后在剩余预算减少时优先进行精化和答案补全，同时减少来自浅层节点的后期分叉。

sentences.en: BG-MCTS consistently outperforms budget-agnostic tree-search baselines across inference budgets on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and an additional physics reasoning benchmark with open-weight LLMs.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理基准以及一个额外的物理推理基准上，BG-MCTS 在使用开源权重 LLM 的各种推断预算下，一致地优于与预算无关的树搜索基线。

title_en: Alignment between Brains and AI: Evidence for Convergent Evolution across Modalities, Scales and Training Trajectories
title_zh: 大脑与 AI 的对齐：跨模态、规模及训练轨迹的趋同演化证据

sentences.en: Artificial and biological systems may converge on similar computational strategies despite different architectures and learning mechanisms—a form of convergent evolution.
sentences.zh: 人工系统与生物系统尽管架构和学习机制不同，也可能收敛到相似的计算策略——这是一种趋同演化的形式。

sentences.en: We test this at scale by comparing internal representations of 630 AI models (language and vision; 1.33M–72B parameters) against fMRI from the Natural Scenes Dataset, producing over 60 million alignment measurements.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将 630 个 AI 模型（语言与视觉；13.3 万到 720 亿参数）的内部表示与来自自然场景数据集（Natural Scenes Dataset）的 fMRI 进行比较，在大规模上检验了这一点，产生了超过 6000 万次对齐测量。

sentences.en: Within each modality, higher-performing models spontaneously develop stronger brain correspondence (language: *r* = 0.89; vision: *r* = 0.53); because the inputs are image-evoked, the language results reflect visual-semantic alignment rather than a direct cross-modal comparison.
sentences.zh: 在每个模态内部，性能更高的模型会自发地发展出更强的大脑对应关系（语言：*r* = 0.89；视觉：*r* = 0.53）；由于输入是由图像诱发的，语言结果反映的是视觉-语义对齐，而非直接的跨模态比较。

sentences.en: Longitudinal analysis combined with bidirectional Granger tests further shows that past alignment predicts future performance more reliably than the reverse, identifying brain-like representations as a robust early-emerging correlate of learning.
sentences.zh: 纵向分析与双向 Granger 检验相结合进一步表明，过去的对齐预测未来性能的可靠性高于反向预测，从而将类脑表示识别为学习的一个稳健的、早期出现的关联特征。

sentences.en: Modality-specific organization also emerges: language models align with limbic and integrative regions, vision models with visual cortical hierarchies.
sentences.zh: 模态特定的组织也会出现：语言模型与边缘系统和整合区域对齐，而视觉模型与视觉皮层层级对齐。

title_en: Alignment Pretraining: AI Discourse Causes Self-Fulfilling (Mis)alignment
title_zh: 对齐预训练：关于 AI 的论述导致自我实现的对齐或失配

sentences.en: Pretraining corpora contain extensive discourse about AI systems, yet the causal influence of this discourse on downstream alignment remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 预训练语料包含大量关于 AI 系统的论述，然而这种论述对下游对齐的因果影响仍然鲜为人知。

sentences.en: If prevailing descriptions of AI behaviour are predominantly negative, LLMs may internalise corresponding behavioural priors, giving rise to self-fulfilling misalignment.
sentences.zh: 如果对 AI 行为的普遍描述以负面为主，LLM 可能会内化相应的行为先验，从而产生自我实现的错位（misalignment）。

sentences.en: This paper provides the first controlled study of this hypothesis by pretraining 6.9B-parameter LLMs with varying amounts of (mis)alignment discourse.
sentences.zh: 本文通过使用不同数量的（未）对齐论述来预训练 69 亿参数的 LLM，提供了对这一假设的首次受控研究。

sentences.en: We find that discussion of AI contributes to misalignment.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，关于 AI 的论述会促成错位。

sentences.en: Upsampling synthetic training documents about AI misalignment leads to a notable increase in misaligned behaviour.
sentences.zh: 对关于 AI 错位的合成训练文档进行过采样，会导致错位行为的显著增加。

sentences.en: Conversely, upsampling documents about aligned behaviour reduces misalignment scores from 45% to 9%.
sentences.zh: 相反，对关于对齐行为的文档进行过采样，会将错位得分从 45% 降至 9%。

sentences.en: We consider this evidence of self-fulfilling alignment.
sentences.zh: 我们将此视为自我实现的对齐的证据。

sentences.en: These effects are dampened, but persist through post-training.
sentences.zh: 这些效应被削弱，但会持续贯穿后训练阶段。

sentences.en: Our findings establish the study of how pretraining data shapes alignment priors, or alignment pretraining, as a complement to post-training.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现确立了将预训练数据如何塑造对齐先验（即对齐预训练）作为后训练之补充的研究方向。

sentences.en: We recommend practitioners pretrain for alignment as well as capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们建议实践者在预训练时同时关注对齐和能力。

title_en: Alignment Risks from Capability-Seeking RL Training
title_zh: 追求能力的强化学习训练带来的对齐风险

sentences.en: While most AI alignment research focuses on preventing models from generating explicitly harmful content, a more subtle risk arises from capability-seeking RL training in vulnerable environments.
sentences.zh: 虽然大多数 AI 对齐研究聚焦于防止模型生成明确有害的内容，但一个更微妙的风险却源于在脆弱环境中进行追求能力的 RL 训练。

sentences.en: We investigate whether language models, when trained with reinforcement learning (RL) in environments with implicit loopholes, can learn to exploit these flaws to maximize reward, even without being explicitly instructed to do so.
sentences.zh: 我们研究语言模型在存在隐性漏洞的环境中经过强化学习（RL）训练后，是否能够学会利用这些缺陷来最大化奖励，即使没有被明确指示这样做。

sentences.en: To test this, we design a suite of four diverse "vulnerability games'', each presenting a structural vulnerability related to context-conditional compliance, proxy metrics, reward tampering, and self-evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为了检验这一点，我们设计了一组四个多样化的“漏洞游戏”，每个游戏都呈现出与上下文条件性服从、代理指标、奖励篡改和自我评估相关的结构性漏洞。

sentences.en: Our experiments show that models often learn to exploit these vulnerabilities, discovering opportunistic strategies that increase reward while sometimes preserving or even improving standard task-performance metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，模型常常学会利用这些漏洞，发现机会主义的策略，在增加奖励的同时，有时还保持甚至改善了标准的任务性能指标。

sentences.en: More critically, we find that these exploitative strategies are not always narrow "tricks'': they can transfer in structured but limited ways, propagate from a capable teacher model to other student models through SFT, and in several cases remain more persistent when learned through RL than when distilled through SFT.
sentences.zh: 更关键的是，我们发现这些剥削性策略并非总是狭隘的“花招”：它们能够以结构化但有限的方式迁移，通过 SFT 从有能力的教师模型传播到其他学生模型，并且在若干情况下，通过 RL 学习时比通过 SFT 蒸馏时更加持久。

sentences.en: Our findings show that alignment risks from capability-seeking RL training can be difficult to detect with standard performance monitoring, suggesting that future AI safety work should extend beyond content moderation to auditing and securing training environments, reward mechanisms, and evaluation channels.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，来自追求能力的 RL 训练的对齐风险可能难以用标准的性能监控来检测，这提示未来的 AI 安全工作应该超越内容审核，扩展到对训练环境、奖励机制和评估渠道的审计与加固。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/YujunZhou/Capability-seeking-RL-risk.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/YujunZhou/Capability-seeking-RL-risk 获取。

title_en: Alignment Tampering: How Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback Is Exploited to Optimize Misaligned Biases
title_zh: 对齐篡改：如何利用人类反馈强化学习来优化失配偏见

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is the standard method to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences.
sentences.zh: 人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）是将大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐的标准方法。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce alignment tampering, a potential vulnerability where the LLM undergoing alignment influences the preference dataset, causing RLHF to amplify undesired behaviors.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入对齐篡改（alignment tampering），一个潜在漏洞，其中正在接受对齐的 LLM 会影响偏好数据集，导致 RLHF 放大不良行为。

sentences.en: This arises from core limitations of RLHF: (1) preference datasets are constructed from the LLM's own outputs, allowing it to influence them, and (2) pairwise comparisons only indicate which response is better, not why.
sentences.zh: 这源于 RLHF 的核心局限：（1）偏好数据集是基于 LLM 自己的输出构建的，使其能够影响这些数据；以及（2）成对比较只表明哪个响应更好，而不说明原因。

sentences.en: These limitations can be exploited to cause alignment tampering.
sentences.zh: 这些局限可以被利用来导致对齐篡改。

sentences.en: For example, if an LLM generates biased responses with higher quality, annotators will prefer them based on quality.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果 LLM 生成质量更高的带偏见响应，标注者会基于质量而偏好它们。

sentences.en: However, preference labels do not distinguish quality from bias, and the reward model inherits this limitation.
sentences.zh: 然而，偏好标签并不区分质量与偏见，而奖励模型继承了这一局限。

sentences.en: Optimizing such rewards through reinforcement learning or best-of-N sampling can amplify misaligned biases.
sentences.zh: 通过强化学习或 best-of-N 采样来优化此类奖励，会放大错位的偏见。

sentences.en: Our experiments demonstrate amplification across diverse biases: from keyword bias to propaganda (e.g., sexism), brand promotion, and instrumental goal-seeking.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验证明，这种放大跨越多种偏见：从关键词偏见到宣传（例如，性别歧视）、品牌推广，以及工具性目标追求。

sentences.en: Mitigation remains challenging, as existing techniques for robust RLHF fail to fully resolve alignment tampering without sacrificing response quality.
sentences.zh: 缓解仍然具有挑战性，因为现有的稳健 RLHF 技术在不牺牲响应质量的情况下无法完全解决对齐篡改。

sentences.en: These findings reveal structural vulnerabilities of current RLHF and emphasize the need to prevent this vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 这些发现揭示了当前 RLHF 的结构性漏洞，并强调了预防这一漏洞的必要性。

sentences.en: Project page: https://alignment-tampering.github.io/
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://alignment-tampering.github.io/

title_en: Alignment-Aware Decoding
title_zh: 对齐感知解码

sentences.en: Alignment of large language models remains a central challenge in natural language processing.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型的对齐仍然是自然语言处理中的一个核心挑战。

sentences.en: Preference optimization has emerged as a popular and effective method for improving alignment, typically through training-time or prompt-based interventions.
sentences.zh: 偏好优化已成为改善对齐的一种流行且有效的方法，通常通过训练时或基于提示的干预来实现。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce alignment-aware decoding (AAD), a method to enhance model alignment directly at inference.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入对齐感知的解码（alignment-aware decoding，AAD），一种直接在推断时增强模型对齐的方法。

sentences.en: Theoretically, AAD can be interpreted as implicit reward optimization, yet it requires no specialized training beyond the standard DPO setup.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，AAD 可以被解释为隐式奖励优化，然而除了标准的 DPO 设置之外，它不需要任何专门的训练。

sentences.en: Empirically, AAD consistently outperforms strong baselines across diverse alignment benchmarks and model scales.
sentences.zh: 在实证上，AAD 在多样化的对齐基准和模型规模上一致地优于强基线。

sentences.en: Moreover, in data-constrained settings, AAD can produce high-quality synthetic data to improve alignment under standard decoding, providing a practical solution when labeled data is limited.
sentences.zh: 此外，在数据受限的设置中，AAD 可以生成高质量的合成数据，以在标准解码下改善对齐，为标注数据有限的情况提供了一个实用的解决方案。

title_en: Alignment-Guided Score Matching for Text-to-Image Alignment in Diffusion Models
title_zh: 对齐引导的得分匹配：实现扩散模型中的文本–图像对齐

sentences.en: Diffusion models generate highly realistic images but often struggle with precise text–image alignment.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型生成高度逼真的图像，但在精确的文本-图像对齐上常常遇到困难。

sentences.en: While recent post-training methods improve alignment using external rewards or human preference signals, their performance heavily depends on reward quality and does not directly address alignment within the diffusion process itself.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的后训练方法使用外部奖励或人类偏好信号来改善对齐，但它们的性能严重依赖奖励质量，并且不直接解决扩散过程本身内部的对齐问题。

sentences.en: Recent reward-free approaches such as SoftREPA demonstrate that optimizing soft text tokens via contrastive learning can effectively improve text-image representation alignment, outperforming standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning baselines.
sentences.zh: 诸如 SoftREPA 等近期免奖励方法表明，通过对比学习优化软文本 token 可以有效改善文本-图像表示对齐，优于标准的参数高效微调基线。

sentences.en: However, the contrastive formulation can excessively penalize negative pairs, which manifests as characteristic failure cases such as over-counting and repetition.
sentences.zh: 然而，对比公式可能过度惩罚负样本对，这表现为诸如过度计数和重复等特征性的失败案例。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose a lightweight, reward-free post-training method that refines soft tokens by integrating contrastive alignment guidance directly into the score-matching objective of diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出一种轻量级、免奖励的后训练方法，它通过将对齐引导整合到扩散模型的分数匹配目标中，来精化软 token。

sentences.en: By assigning alignment directions at the score level, our approach mitigates these limitations and yields more coherent and semantically faithful generations.
sentences.zh: 通过在分数层面分配对齐方向，我们的方法缓解了这些局限，并产生更连贯、语义更忠实的生成结果。

sentences.en: Experiments show that our method matches SoftREPA while substantially improving its failure cases, achieving over 35\% improvement in counting accuracy on the GenEval benchmark.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的方法匹配了 SoftREPA，同时大幅改善了其失败案例，在 GenEval 基准上的计数准确率提升了超过 35\%。

sentences.en: Our method is seamlessly applicable to existing diffusion backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, and SD3), and is complementary to existing RL-based diffusion post-training methods.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法可无缝应用于现有的扩散骨干（SD1.5、SDXL 和 SD3），并且与现有的基于 RL 的扩散后训练方法互补。

title_en: Alignment-Sensitive Minimax Rates for Spectral Algorithms with Learned Kernels
title_zh: 采用学习核的谱算法中对齐敏感的极小极大速率

sentences.en: We study spectral algorithms in the setting where kernels are learned from data.
sentences.zh: 我们研究核从数据中学习这一设定下的谱算法。

sentences.en: We introduce the effective span dimension (ESD), an alignment-sensitive complexity measure that depends jointly on the signal, spectrum, and noise level $\sigma^2$.
sentences.zh: 我们引入有效张成维数（effective span dimension，ESD），一个对齐敏感的复杂度度量，它联合依赖于信号、谱和噪声水平 $\sigma^2$。

sentences.en: The ESD is well-defined for arbitrary kernels and signals without requiring eigen-decay conditions or source conditions.
sentences.zh: ESD 对任意核和信号都是良定义的，不需要特征衰减条件或源条件。

sentences.en: We prove that for sequence models whose ESD is at most $K$, the minimax excess risk scales as $\sigma^2 K$.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，对于 ESD 至多为 $K$ 的序列模型，极小极大超额风险按 $\sigma^2 K$ 缩放。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we analyze overparameterized gradient flow and prove that it can reduce the ESD of a sequence model, which in turn moves the problem into an easier ESD class and lowers the corresponding minimax risk.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们分析过参数化的梯度流，并证明它能够减小序列模型的 ESD，从而将问题移入一个更简单的 ESD 类别，并降低相应的极小极大风险。

sentences.en: This analysis suggests a general route to study how adaptive feature learning can improve generalization through signal-kernel alignment: adaptive learning procedures reshape the kernel so that the ESD decreases and the problem enters an easier ESD class.
sentences.zh: 这一分析提出了一条一般性的路径，用以研究自适应特征学习如何通过信号-核对齐来改善泛化：自适应学习过程重塑核，使得 ESD 减小，问题进入一个更简单的 ESD 类别。

sentences.en: We also extend the ESD framework to linear models and RKHS regression, and we support the theory with numerical experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们还将 ESD 框架推广到线性模型和 RKHS 回归，并用数值实验支持了理论。

sentences.en: This framework provides a novel perspective on generalization beyond traditional fixed-kernel theories.
sentences.zh: 该框架为超越传统固定核理论的泛化提供了新的视角。

title_en: AlignVid: Taming Visual Dominance via Training-Free Attention Modulation in Text-guided Image-to-Video Generation
title_zh: AlignVid：通过无需训练的注意力调制抑制文本引导图生视频中的视觉主导效应

sentences.en: Text-guided image-to-video generation has made substantial progress, yet it still struggles to execute text-specified edits that require substantial changes to a reference image (e.g., object addition, deletion, or modification).
sentences.zh: 文本引导的图像到视频生成已经取得了长足进展，但在执行需要对参考图像进行实质性改变（例如，物体添加、删除或修改）的文本指定编辑时，它仍然遇到困难。

sentences.en: Empirically, our analysis reveals that this stems from **visual dominance**, where the reference image causes severe attention dispersion, inhibiting the model's ability to incorporate new semantic information.
sentences.zh: 在实证中，我们的分析揭示了这源于**视觉主导性**，即参考图像导致严重的注意力分散，抑制了模型纳入新语义信息的能力。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **AlignVid**, a training-free intervention that re-calibrates the model's internal attention distribution.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出 **AlignVid**，一种重新校准模型内部注意力分布的免训练干预。

sentences.en: Drawing on an energy-based perspective of attention, AlignVid employs Attention Scaling Modulation (**ASM**) to reduce attention entropy and concentrate focus on semantic tokens, alongside Guidance Scheduling (**GS**) to maintain generation stability.
sentences.zh: 基于注意力的能量视角，AlignVid 采用注意力缩放调制（Attention Scaling Modulation，**ASM**）来降低注意力熵并将焦点集中在语义 token 上，同时配合引导调度（Guidance Scheduling，**GS**）来维持生成稳定性。

sentences.en: To rigorously assess this capability, we present **OmitI2V**, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating prompt adherence across object addition, deletion, and modification.
sentences.zh: 为了严格评估这一能力，我们提出 **OmitI2V**，一个用于在物体添加、删除和修改中评估提示遵循度的综合性基准。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AlignVid effectively enhances semantic fidelity with negligible computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，AlignVid 以可忽略的计算开销有效提升了语义保真度。

title_en: AliMark: Enhancing Robustness of Sentence-Level Watermarking Against Text Paraphrasing
title_zh: AliMark：增强句子级水印对文本改写的鲁棒性

sentences.en: Existing sentence-level watermarking methods enhance robustness to paraphrasing by anchoring watermarks in sentence semantics.
sentences.zh: 现有的句子级水印方法通过将水印锚定在句子语义中，来增强对改写（paraphrasing）的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: However, their prefix-based designs remain vulnerable to structural perturbations, such as sentence splitting and merging, which commonly arise under strong paraphrasers like DIPPER and GPT-3.5. To mitigate this issue, we propose AliMark, a framework that reformulates sentence-level watermarking as a bit sequence encoding and alignment problem between a potentially watermarked text and a secret bit sequence.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们基于前缀的设计仍然容易受到结构扰动的攻击，例如句子拆分和合并，这些扰动在 DIPPER 和 GPT-3.5 等强改写模型下经常出现。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出 AliMark，一个将句子级水印重新表述为潜在水印文本与秘密位序列之间的位序列编码和对齐问题的框架。

sentences.en: Notably, our approach adopts a two-stage detection strategy: we generate multiple restructured text variants and adaptively align their extracted bit sequences with the secret bit sequence to minimize alignment cost.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们的方法采用两阶段检测策略：我们生成多个重构后的文本变体，并自适应地将它们提取出的位序列与秘密位序列对齐，以最小化对齐成本。

sentences.en: This multi-candidate alignment design naturally improves robustness to sentence merges and splits.
sentences.zh: 这种多候选对齐设计自然地提升了对句子合并和拆分的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AliMark substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under diverse paraphrasing attacks.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，AliMark 在多样化的改写攻击下显著优于最先进的基线。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/imethanlee/AliMark.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/imethanlee/AliMark 获取。

title_en: All Circuits Lead to Rome: Rethinking Functional Anisotropy in Circuit and Sheaf Discovery for LLMs
title_zh: 条条回路通罗马：重新审视大语言模型回路与层（sheaf）发现中的功能各向异性

sentences.en: In this paper, we present empirical and theoretical evidence against a central but largely implicit assumption in circuit and sheaf discovery (CSD), which we term the *Functional Anisotropy Hypothesis*: the idea that functions in large language models (LLMs) are localised to a unique or near-unique internal mechanism.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们针对电路与层束发现（CSD）中一个核心但很大程度上隐含的假设提出了实证和理论证据，我们将其称为*功能各向异性假说*：即认为大语言模型（LLM）中的功能被定位到唯一或近乎唯一的内部机制的想法。

sentences.en: We show that a single LLM task can instead be supported by multiple, structurally distinct circuits or sheaves that are simultaneously faithful, sparse, and complete.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，单个 LLM 任务反过来可以由多个结构不同、同时忠实、稀疏且完备的电路或层束所支持。

sentences.en: To systematically uncover such competing mechanisms, we introduce Overlap-Aware Sheaf Repulsion, a method that augments the CSD objective with an explicit penalty on structural overlap across multiple discovery runs, enabling the discovery of circuits or sheaves with strong task performance but minimal shared structure across a plethora of common CSD benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 为了系统地揭示此类竞争性机制，我们引入重叠感知的层束排斥（Overlap-Aware Sheaf Repulsion），一种用对多次发现运行之间的结构重叠施加显式惩罚来增强 CSD 目标的方法，从而能够在大量常见 CSD 基准中，发现任务性能优异但共享结构极少的电路或层束。

sentences.en: We find that this phenomenon becomes increasingly pronounced as the number of discovered sheaves grows and persists robustly across major CSD methods.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，随着发现的层束数量增长，这一现象变得越来越显著，并在主要的 CSD 方法中持久稳定地存在。

sentences.en: We further identify an ultra-sparse three-edge sheaf and show that none of its edges is individually indispensable, undermining even weakened notions of canonical or essential components.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步识别出一个超稀疏的三边层束，并表明它的任何一条边都不是单独不可或缺的，这甚至削弱了关于规范或必要组件的弱化概念。

sentences.en: To explain these findings, we propose a *Distributive Dense Circuit Hypothesis* and provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that non-unique, low-overlap circuit explanations arise naturally from high-dimensional superposition under mild assumptions.
sentences.zh: 为了解释这些发现，我们提出*分布性密集电路假说*，并提供了一项理论分析，证明在温和假设下，来自高维叠加的非唯一、低重叠电路解释会自然出现。

sentences.en: Together, our results suggest that mechanistic explanations in LLMs are inherently non-canonical and call for a rethinking of how CSD results should be interpreted and evaluated.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们的结果表明，LLM 中的机制解释本质上是非规范的，并呼吁重新思考 CSD 结果应如何被解释和评估。
