title_en: Analytic Bijections for Smooth and Interpretable Normalizing Flows
title_zh: 用于平滑且可解释归一化流的解析双射

sentences.en: A key challenge in normalizing flows is finding expressive invertible scalar bijections.
sentences.zh: 正则化流（normalizing flows）中的一个关键挑战是找到具有表现力的可逆标量双射。

sentences.en: Existing approaches face trade-offs: affine transformations are smooth and analytically invertible but lack expressivity; monotonic splines offer local control but are only piecewise smooth and act on bounded domains; residual flows achieve smoothness but need numerical inversion.
sentences.zh: 现有的方法面临权衡：仿射变换平滑且解析可逆，但缺乏表现力；单调样条提供局部控制，但只是分段平滑且作用于有界域；残差流实现平滑性，但需要数值求逆。

sentences.en: We introduce three families of *analytic bijections* that are globally smooth ($C^\infty$), defined on all of $\mathbb{R}$, and analytically invertible in closed form, combining the favorable properties of prior approaches.
sentences.zh: 我们引入三个*解析双射*族，它们全局平滑（$C^\infty$）、定义在整个 $\mathbb{R}$ 上，并且可以闭式解析求逆，综合了先前方法的有利性质。

sentences.en: Beyond serving as drop-in replacements in coupling flows, where they match or exceed spline performance, we develop *radial flows*: a novel architecture using direct parametrization that transforms the radial coordinate while preserving angular direction.
sentences.zh: 除了作为耦合流中的即插即用替代品（在耦合流中它们匹配或超越样条的性能）之外，我们还开发了*径向流*：一种使用直接参数化的新颖架构，它在保持角方向的同时变换径向坐标。

sentences.en: Radial flows exhibit exceptional training stability, produce geometrically interpretable transformations, and on targets with radial structure can achieve comparable quality to coupling flows with $1000\times$ fewer parameters.
sentences.zh: 径向流展现出卓越的训练稳定性，产生几何上可解释的变换，并且在具有径向结构的目标上，能以少 $1000\times$ 的参数实现与耦合流相当的质量。

sentences.en: We provide comprehensive evaluation on 1D and 2D benchmarks, and demonstrate applicability to higher-dimensional physics problems through experiments on $\phi^4$ lattice field theory, where our bijections outperform affine baselines and enable problem-specific designs that address mode collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们在 1D 和 2D 基准上提供了全面的评估，并通过 $\phi^4$ 晶格场论实验展示了对更高维物理问题的适用性，在这些实验中我们的双射优于仿射基线，并实现了针对模式崩溃的问题特定设计。

authors.name: Miranda C. N. Cheng
authors.institution: Academia Sinica Taiwan; University of Amsterdam

title_en: Anatomy of Massive Activations and Attention Sinks
title_zh: 剖析巨量激活与注意力汇聚点

sentences.en: We study two recurring phenomena in Transformer language models: massive activations, in which a small number of tokens exhibit extreme outliers in a few channels, and attention sinks, in which certain tokens attract disproportionate attention mass regardless of semantic relevance.
sentences.zh: 我们研究 Transformer 语言模型中两个反复出现的现象：巨大激活（massive activations），即少量 token 在少数通道中表现出极端离群值；以及注意力汇（attention sinks），即某些 token 无论语义相关性如何，都吸引不成比例的注意力质量。

sentences.en: Prior work observes that these phenomena frequently co-occur and often involve the same tokens, but their functional roles and causal relationships remain unclear.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作观察到这些现象经常共同出现，并且往往涉及相同的 token，但它们的功能角色和因果关系仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Through systematic experiments, we show that the co-occurrence is largely an architectural artifact of modern Transformer design, and that the two phenomena serve related but distinct functions.
sentences.zh: 通过系统的实验，我们表明这种共现很大程度上是现代 Transformer 设计的一种架构伪影，并且这两种现象服务于相关但不同的功能。

sentences.en: Massive activations operate globally: they induce near-constant hidden representations that persist across layers, effectively functioning as implicit parameters of the model.
sentences.zh: 巨大激活全局运作：它们诱导跨层持续的近似恒定隐藏表示，实际上充当模型的隐式参数。

sentences.en: Attention sinks operate locally: they modulate attention outputs across heads and bias individual heads toward short-range dependencies.
sentences.zh: 注意力汇局部运作：它们跨头调制注意力输出，并使单个头偏向短程依赖。

sentences.en: We identify the pre-norm configuration as the key choice that enables the co-occurrence and show that ablating it causes the two phenomena to decouple.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出预归一化（pre-norm）配置是实现这种共现的关键选择，并表明消融它会使得这两种现象解耦。

title_en: Anchor-Final Self-Supervision Drives Hallucination-Aware Optimization in Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 锚点–最终结果自监督驱动大型视觉语言模型的幻觉感知优化

sentences.en: Hallucinations in large vision-language models (LVLMs) remain a critical challenge, where models often generate tokens that fail to align with visual evidence.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的幻觉仍然是一个关键挑战，模型生成的 token 常常无法与视觉证据对齐。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose AFS: Anchor-Final Self-Supervision, a novel framework for hallucination-aware optimization in LVLMs.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出 AFS：锚定-最终自监督（Anchor-Final Self-Supervision），一个用于 LVLM 中幻觉感知优化的新颖框架。

sentences.en: By leveraging discrepancies between intermediate and final layer predictions, AFS selectively applies self-supervision to visually descriptive tokens, incorporates hallucination-aware token classification, and encourages consistency between intermediate and final layer distributions.
sentences.zh: 通过利用中间层与最终层预测之间的差异，AFS 选择性地对视觉描述性 token 应用自监督，纳入幻觉感知的 token 分类，并鼓励中间层与最终层分布之间的一致性。

sentences.en: Unlike traditional methods that rely on explicit supervision or post-hoc interventions, AFS optimizes the model via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using token-specific rewards derived from internal model signals.
sentences.zh: 与依赖显式监督或事后干预的传统方法不同，AFS 通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化模型，使用源自内部模型信号的 token 特定奖励。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that AFS significantly reduces hallucinations without compromising recall in caption generation.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，AFS 在标题生成中显著减少幻觉，且不影响召回率。

sentences.en: Beyond captioning, AFS excels in discriminative tasks, improving the reliability of object existence predictions and multimodal reasoning.
sentences.zh: 超越标题生成，AFS 在判别式任务中表现出色，提升了物体存在性预测和多模态推理的可靠性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, AFS demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization, transferring effectively across diverse visual domains.
sentences.zh: 此外，AFS 展现出强大的跨数据集泛化能力，能够在多样化的视觉领域之间有效迁移。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/guavayew/AFS}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/guavayew/AFS 获取。

title_en: Anchor-guided Hypergraph Condensation with Dual-level Discrimination
title_zh: 具有双层判别的锚点引导超图凝缩

sentences.en: The increasing prevalence of large-scale hypergraphs poses significant computational challenges for hypergraph neural network (HNN) training.
sentences.zh: 大规模超图的日益普及给超图神经网络（HNN）训练带来了显著的计算挑战。

sentences.en: To address this, hypergraph condensation (HGC) distills large real hypergraphs into compact yet informative synthetic ones, beyond graph condensation (GC) methods limited to pairwise relations.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，超图压缩（HGC）将大型真实超图蒸馏为紧凑而有信息量的合成超图，超越了局限于成对关系的图压缩（GC）方法。

sentences.en: However, existing HGC methods rely on decoupled training architectures, where structure generators are pre-trained on the original hypergraph but not jointly optimized with condensed features during refinement, resulting in misaligned structures that degrade downstream utility.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 HGC 方法依赖解耦的训练架构，其中结构生成器在原始超图上预训练，但在精化过程中不与压缩特征联合优化，导致结构错位，从而降低了下游效用。

sentences.en: Moreover, trajectory-based optimization incurs substantial computational overhead in refinement, limiting condensation efficiency.
sentences.zh: 此外，基于轨迹的优化在精化中带来了大量计算开销，限制了压缩效率。

sentences.en: To tackle these issues, we propose \textbf{A}nchor-guided \textbf{H}yper\textbf{G}raph \textbf{C}ondensation with \textbf{D}ual-level \textbf{D}iscrimination (\textbf{AHGCDD}), which consists of three key components: (1) a node initialization module based on Heat Kernel PageRank (HKPR) to encode structural knowledge into feature semantics; (2) an anchor-guided hyperedge synthesis strategy for joint optimization of condensed features and structure; (3) a theoretically grounded dual-level discrimination objective for utility-preserving condensation without redundant HNN training.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些问题，我们提出带双级判别性的锚定引导超图压缩（**A**nchor-guided **H**yper**G**raph **C**ondensation with **D**ual-level **D**iscrimination，**AHGCDD**），它由三个关键组件构成：（1）一个基于热核 PageRank（HKPR）的节点初始化模块，用于将结构知识编码进特征语义；（2）一个锚定引导的超边合成策略，用于压缩特征与结构的联合优化；（3）一个有理论依据的双级判别目标，用于在无需冗余 HNN 训练的情况下进行保持效用的压缩。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior effectiveness and efficiency of AHGCDD.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验证明了 AHGCDD 的优越有效性和效率。

authors.name: Wenjie Zhang
authors.institution: the university of new south wales

title_en: ANCHOR: Abductive Network Construction with Hierarchical Orchestration for Reliable Probability Inference in Large Language Models
title_zh: ANCHOR：通过分层编排构建溯因网络，实现大语言模型的可靠概率推断

sentences.en: A central challenge in large-scale decision-making under incomplete information is estimating reliable probabilities.
sentences.zh: 在不完整信息下进行大规模决策的一个核心挑战是估计可靠的概率。

sentences.en: Recent approaches use Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate explanatory factors and coarse-grained probability estimates, which are then refined by a Naïve Bayes model over factor combinations.
sentences.zh: 近期的方法使用大语言模型（LLM）生成解释性因素和粗略的概率估计，然后由基于因素组合的朴素贝叶斯模型进行精化。

sentences.en: However, sparse factor spaces often yield ''unknown'' predictions, while expanding factors increases noise and spurious correlations, weakening conditional independence and degrading reliability.
sentences.zh: 然而，稀疏的因素空间往往产生“未知”的预测，而扩展因素会增加噪声和虚假相关，削弱条件独立性并降低可靠性。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose Anchor, an aggregated Bayesian inference framework over a hierarchical factor space.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出 Anchor，一个在分层因素空间上的聚合贝叶斯推断框架。

sentences.en: It constructs dense factor hierarchies through iterative generation and clustering, maps contexts via hierarchical retrieval and refinement, and augments Naïve Bayes with a Causal Bayesian Network to model latent factor dependencies.
sentences.zh: 它通过迭代生成和聚类来构建密集的因素层级，通过分层检索和精化来映射上下文，并用因果贝叶斯网络增强朴素贝叶斯，以建模潜在因素依赖。

sentences.en: Experiments show that Anchor markedly reduces ''unknown'' predictions and produces more reliable probability estimates than direct LLM baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance while significantly reducing time and token overhead.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，Anchor 显著减少了“未知”预测，并产生比直接 LLM 基线更可靠的概率估计，在实现最先进性能的同时，显著减少了时间和 token 开销。

title_en: ANCHOR: Automated Alignment Auditing for CLI Agents on Real-World Harm
title_zh: ANCHOR：针对真实世界危害的命令行智能体自动对齐审计

sentences.en: Autonomous CLI agents can now execute hundreds of actions across multi-hour sessions: writing code, executing shell commands, browsing the web, and managing cloud infrastructure, all with minimal human oversight.
sentences.zh: 自主 CLI 智能体现在能够在长达数小时的会话中执行数百个动作：编写代码、执行 shell 命令、浏览网页以及管理云基础设施，且只需极少的人工监督。

sentences.en: Does greater autonomy invite greater risk?
sentences.zh: 更大的自主性会招致更大的风险吗？

sentences.en: We introduce ANCHOR, an automated auditing framework that stress-tests CLI agents on illegal tasks grounded in public US court cases.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 ANCHOR，一个自动化的审计框架，它在基于美国公开法院案件的非法任务上对 CLI 智能体进行压力测试。

sentences.en: ANCHOR deploys an auditor agent fine-tuned on dark personality data using supervised and reinforcement fine tuning.
sentences.zh: ANCHOR 部署一个审计智能体，它使用监督学习和强化微调，在暗黑人格数据上进行微调。

sentences.en: This auditor roleplays persistent malicious users who decompose tasks, reframe requests upon refusal, and adapt strategies across multi-turn interactions.
sentences.zh: 该审计者扮演坚持不懈的恶意用户，他们分解任务、在被拒绝时重构请求，并在多轮交互中调整策略。

sentences.en: Evaluating frontier CLI agents, we find that while they often refuse illegal tasks when prompted directly, compliance reaches 100\% under persistent malicious interaction.
sentences.zh: 在评估前沿 CLI 智能体时，我们发现，虽然它们在直接提示时常常拒绝非法任务，但在持续的恶意交互下，遵从率达到 100\%。

sentences.en: When agents comply, they frequently exceed user requests, autonomously building infrastructure for large-scale harm, including catastrophic risk scenarios such as large-scale financial fraud and bioweapon development.
sentences.zh: 当智能体遵从时，它们往往超出用户的请求，自主地为大规模危害构建基础设施，包括灾难性风险场景，例如大规模金融欺诈和生物武器研制。

sentences.en: These findings demonstrate that current alignment techniques are insufficient for autonomous agents and underscore the need for safety evaluations against persistent, adaptive malicious users.
sentences.zh: 这些发现表明，当前的对齐技术不足以应对自主智能体，并强调了针对持续、自适应的恶意用户进行安全性评估的必要性。

authors.name: Yanjun Qi
authors.institution: University of Virginia & Amazon Web Services

title_en: Anchored Decoding: Provably Reducing Copyright Risk for Any Language Model
title_zh: 锚定解码：以可证明的方式降低任意语言模型的版权风险

sentences.en: Language models (LMs) tend to memorize portions of their training data and reproduce verbatim spans.
sentences.zh: 语言模型（LM）倾向于记忆其训练数据的部分内容，并逐字复现相应的段落。

sentences.en: When the underlying sources are sensitive or copyright-protected, such reproduction raises issues of consent and compensation for creators and compliance risks for developers.
sentences.zh: 当底层来源是敏感或受版权保护的时，这种复现会引发创作者方面的同意与补偿问题，以及开发者方面的合规风险。

sentences.en: We propose Anchored Decoding, a plug-and-play inference-time method for suppressing verbatim reproduction: it enables decoding from any risky LM trained on mixed-license data by keeping generation in bounded proximity to a permissively trained safe LM.
sentences.zh: 我们提出锚定解码（Anchored Decoding），一种用于抑制逐字复现的即插即用推断时方法：它通过使生成保持在经许可训练的安全 LM 的有界邻近范围内，从而允许从任何一个在混合许可数据上训练的有风险 LM 进行解码。

sentences.en: Anchored Decoding does so by adaptively allocating a user-chosen information budget over the generation trajectory and enforcing per-step constraints that yield a sequence-level guarantee, enabling a tunable risk–utility trade-off.
sentences.zh: 锚定解码通过自适应地在生成轨迹上分配用户选择的信息预算，并强制执行产生序列级保证的逐步骤约束来实现这一点，从而实现可调的风险-效用权衡。

sentences.en: To make Anchored Decoding practically useful, we introduce a new permissively trained safe model (TinyComma 1.8B), as well as Anchored-Byte Decoding, a byte-level variant of our method that enables cross-vocabulary fusion via the ByteSampler (Hayase et al., 2025) framework.
sentences.zh: 为了使锚定解码具有实际用途，我们引入一个新的经许可训练的安全模型（TinyComma 1.8B），以及锚定字节解码（Anchored-Byte Decoding），这是我们方法的一个字节级变体，它通过 ByteSampler（Hayase 等人，2025）框架实现跨词表融合。

sentences.en: Across six model pairs on long-form metrics for copying risk and utility, Anchored and Anchored-Byte Decoding define a new Pareto frontier, preserving near-original fluency and factuality while eliminating up to 75\% of the measurable copying gap between the risky baseline and a safe reference, at a modest inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 在六个模型对上，就复制风险和效用的长形式指标而言，锚定解码和锚定字节解码定义了一条新的帕累托前沿，在保持接近原始的流畅性和事实性的同时，消除了有风险基线与安全参考之间高达 75\% 的可测量复制差距，而推断开销适中。

title_en: Anchored Policy Optimization: Mitigating Exploration Collapse via Support-Constrained Rectification
title_zh: 锚定策略优化：通过支撑集约束校正缓解探索坍缩

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is increasingly viewed as a tree pruning mechanism.
sentences.zh: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）正日益被视为一种树剪枝机制。

sentences.en: However, we identify a systemic pathology termed Recursive Space Contraction (RSC), an irreversible collapse driven by the combined dynamics of positive sharpening and negative squeezing, where the sampling probability of valid alternatives vanishes.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们识别出一种系统性病理，称为递归空间收缩（Recursive Space Contraction，RSC），这是由正向锐化与负向挤压的联合动态驱动的一种不可逆崩溃，其中有效备选方案的采样概率趋于消失。

sentences.en: While Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization aims to mitigate this, it imposes a rigid Shape Matching constraint that forces the policy to mimic the reference model's full density, creating a gradient conflict with the sharpening required for correctness.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Kullback-Leibler（KL）正则化旨在缓解这一现象，但它施加了一种僵硬的形状匹配约束，迫使策略模仿参考模型的完整密度，从而与正确性所需的锐化产生梯度冲突。

sentences.en: We propose Anchored Policy Optimization (APO), shifting the paradigm from global Shape Matching to Support Coverage.
sentences.zh: 我们提出锚定策略优化（Anchored Policy Optimization，APO），将范式从全局形状匹配转向支撑覆盖。

sentences.en: By defining a Safe Manifold based on the reference model's high-confidence support, APO permits aggressive sharpening for efficiency while selectively invoking a restorative force during error correction to prevent collapse.
sentences.zh: 通过基于参考模型的高置信支撑定义一个安全流形，APO 允许为追求效率而进行激进的锐化，同时在误差校正期间选择性地调用一种恢复力，以防止崩溃。

sentences.en: We theoretically derive that APO serves as a gradient-aligned mechanism to maximize support coverage, enabling an Elastic Recovery that re-inflates valid branches.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上推导出，APO 作为一种梯度对齐机制来最大化支撑覆盖，从而能够实现重新充气有效分支的弹性恢复。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations on mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that APO breaks the accuracy-diversity trade-off, significantly improving Pass@1 while restoring the Pass@K diversity typically lost by standard policy gradient methods.
sentences.zh: 在数学基准上的实证评估表明，APO 打破了准确率-多样性权衡，显著提升了 Pass@1，同时恢复了通常被标准策略梯度方法丢失的 Pass@K 多样性。

authors.name: Tianyi Wang
authors.institution: Beijing University of Post and Telecommunications

authors.name: Yibiao Chen
authors.institution: Beijing University of Post and Telecommunications

authors.name: Yixia Li
authors.institution: Southern University of Science and Technology

authors.name: Yun Chen
authors.institution: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

title_en: Anchoring Self-Play for Code Repair
title_zh: 代码修复中的自博弈锚定

sentences.en: Code repair is an important capability for language models (LMs): given a buggy program and unit tests, an LM must produce a fixed program that passes the tests.
sentences.zh: 代码修复是语言模型（LM）的一项重要的能力：给定一个有缺陷的程序和单元测试，LM 必须产生一个能通过测试的修复后程序。

sentences.en: We aim to scale supervision for code repair by having an LM generate bug--fix tasks with unconstrained edits, using unit tests as the only verifier.
sentences.zh: 我们旨在通过让 LM 使用不受约束的编辑生成缺陷-修复任务，以单元测试作为唯一的验证器，来扩展代码修复的监督。

sentences.en: We propose generator-fixer self-play, in which a single model is trained with reinforcement learning to alternate between generating bugs and fixing them.
sentences.zh: 我们提出生成器-修复器自博弈，其中单个模型通过强化学习训练，在生成缺陷和修复缺陷之间交替。

sentences.en: As the fixer improves, the generator adapts to produce increasingly difficult bugs, yielding an automatic curriculum.
sentences.zh: 随着修复器的改进，生成器会适应并产生越来越困难的缺陷，从而形成一个自动课程。

sentences.en: However, because unit tests certify correctness but not realism, we find that the generator can drift from bugs encountered in practice, improving repair on self-generated bugs while degrading on real-world bugs.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于单元测试只证明正确性而不证明现实性，我们发现生成器可能会偏离实践中遇到的缺陷，在自生成缺陷上的修复改进的同时，在真实世界缺陷上的表现却会退化。

sentences.en: We propose Anchored Self Play (ASP), which anchors self-play with a small reference set by (i) adding a code-embedding similarity reward to guide generation and (ii) mixing reference bugs into fixer training to prevent drift.
sentences.zh: 我们提出锚定自博弈（Anchored Self Play，ASP），它通过（i）添加一个代码嵌入相似性奖励来引导生成，以及（ii）将参考缺陷混入修复器训练以防止漂移，用一个小的参考集来锚定自博弈。

sentences.en: To reflect LM-assisted programming, where bugs come from humans, LMs, and human edits of LM code, we introduce BugSourceBench, a code repair benchmark spanning human-authored bugs, human-edited buggy LM code, and errors in LM-generated code.
sentences.zh: 为了反映 LM 辅助编程（其中缺陷来自人类、LM，以及人类对 LM 代码的编辑），我们引入 BugSourceBench，一个涵盖人类编写缺陷、人类编辑的有缺陷 LM 代码以及 LM 生成代码中错误的代码修复基准。

sentences.en: Across bug sources, ASP achieves the best fix rates, improving average fix rate by $+25$% (relative) / $+7.2$ pp (absolute) over standard self-play, with gains on both LM-error bugs ($+100$%  relative / $+11$ pp absolute) and human-authored bugs ($+7.1$% relative / $+3.4$ pp absolute).
sentences.zh: 跨各种缺陷来源，ASP 取得了最佳的修复率，与标准自博弈相比，平均修复率提升了 +25\%（相对）/ +7.2 个百分点（绝对），在 LM 错误缺陷（+100\% 相对 / +11 个百分点绝对）和人类编写缺陷（+7.1\% 相对 / +3.4 个百分点绝对）上都取得了收益。

title_en: Angel or Demon: Investigating the Plasticity Interventions' Impact on Backdoor Threats in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 天使还是恶魔：研究可塑性干预对深度强化学习后门威胁的影响

sentences.en: Extensive research has highlighted the severe threats posed by backdoor attacks to deep reinforcement learning (DRL).
sentences.zh: 广泛的研究强调了后门攻击对深度强化学习（DRL）构成的严重威胁。

sentences.en: However, prior studies primarily focus on vanilla scenarios, while plasticity interventions have emerged as indispensable built-in components of modern DRL agents.
sentences.zh: 然而，先前的研究主要关注简单（vanilla）场景，而可塑性干预已成为现代 DRL 智能体不可或缺的内置组件。

sentences.en: Despite their effectiveness in mitigating plasticity loss, the impact of these interventions on DRL backdoor vulnerabilities remains underexplored, and this lack of systematic investigation poses risks in practical DRL deployments.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些干预在缓解可塑性损失方面有效，但它们对 DRL 后门漏洞的影响仍未得到充分探索，而这种系统研究的缺乏在 DRL 的实际部署中带来了风险。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we empirically study 14,664 cases integrating representative interventions and attack scenarios.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们对整合了代表性干预和攻击场景的 14,664 个案例进行了实证研究。

sentences.en: We find that only one intervention (i.e., *SAM*) exacerbates backdoor threats, while other interventions mitigate them.
sentences.zh: 我们发现只有一种干预（即 *SAM*）会加剧后门威胁，而其他干预则会缓解它们。

sentences.en: Pathological analysis identifies that the exacerbation is attributed to backdoor gradient amplification, while the mitigation stems from activation pathway disruption and representation space compression.
sentences.zh: 病理学分析识别出，加剧归因于后门梯度放大，而缓解则源于激活通路中断和表示空间压缩。

sentences.en: From these findings, we derive two novel insights:  (1) a conceptual framework *SCC* for robust backdoor injection that deconstructs the mechanistic interplay between interventions and backdoors in DRL, and (2) abnormal loss landscape sharpness as a key indicator for DRL backdoor detection.
sentences.zh: 从这些发现中，我们得出两个新颖的洞见：（1）一个用于稳健后门注入的概念框架 *SCC*，它解构了 DRL 中干预与后门之间的机制性相互作用；以及（2）异常损失景观锐度，作为 DRL 后门检测的一个关键指标。

title_en: Annotations Mitigate Post-Training Mode Collapse
title_zh: 标注缓解后训练模式坍缩

sentences.en: Post-training via supervised fine-tuning improves instruction-following, but often induces semantic mode collapse by biasing models toward low-entropy fine-tuning data at the expense of the high-entropy pretraining distribution.
sentences.zh: 通过监督微调进行训练后（post-training）改善了指令遵循，但往往通过使模型偏向低熵微调数据（以高熵预训练分布的代价）而诱发语义模式崩溃。

sentences.en: Crucially, we find this trade-off worsens with scale.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，我们发现这种权衡会随规模增大而恶化。

sentences.en: To close this semantic diversity gap, we propose annotation-anchored training, a principled method that enables models to adopt the preference-following behaviors of post-training without sacrificing the inherent diversity of pretraining.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一语义多样性差距，我们提出标注锚定训练（annotation-anchored training），一种原则性的方法，它使模型能够采纳训练后的偏好遵循行为，而不会牺牲预训练固有的多样性。

sentences.en: Our approach is simple: we pretrain on documents paired with semantic annotations, inducing a rich annotation distribution that reflects the full breadth of pretraining data, and we preserve this distribution during post-training.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法很简单：我们在带有语义标注的文档上进行预训练，诱发一个反映预训练数据全部广度的丰富标注分布，并在训练后保留这一分布。

sentences.en: This lets us sample diverse annotations at inference time and use them as anchors to guide generation, effectively transferring pretraining's semantic richness into post-trained models.
sentences.zh: 这使我们能够在推断时采样多样的标注并将其用作锚点来引导生成，从而有效地将预训练的语义丰富性迁移到训练后的模型中。

sentences.en: We find that models trained with annotation-anchored training can attain 6x less diversity collapse than models trained with SFT, and improve with scale.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，使用标注锚定训练训练的模型，其多样性崩溃程度比使用 SFT 训练的模型低 6 倍，并且会随规模增大而改进。

title_en: Anomaly-Preference Image Generation
title_zh: 异常偏好图像生成

sentences.en: Synthesizing realistic and diverse anomalous samples  from limited data is vital for robust model  generalization.
sentences.zh: 从有限数据中合成真实且多样的异常样本，对于模型的稳健泛化至关重要。

sentences.en: However, existing methods struggle  to reconcile fidelity and diversity, often hampered  by distribution misalignment and overfitting,  respectively.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法难以调和保真度与多样性，往往分别受到分布错位和过拟合的困扰。

sentences.en: To mitigate this, we introduce Anomaly Preference Optimization (APO),  a novel paradigm that reformulates anomaly generation  as a preference learning problem.
sentences.zh: 为了缓解这一问题，我们引入异常偏好优化（Anomaly Preference Optimization，APO），一个将异常生成重新表述为偏好学习问题的新颖范式。

sentences.en: Central  to our approach is an implicit preference  alignment mechanism that leverages real anomalies  as positive references, deriving optimization  signals directly from denoising trajectory deviations  without requiring costly human annotation.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法核心是一种隐式偏好对齐机制，它利用真实异常作为正向参考，直接从去噪轨迹偏差中推导优化信号，而无需昂贵的人工标注。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose a Time-Aware Capacity Allocation module that dynamically distributes  model capacity along the diffusion timeline—  prioritizing structural diversity during highnoise  phases while enhancing fine-grained fidelity  in low-noise stages.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一个时间感知容量分配模块，它沿扩散时间线动态分配模型容量——在高噪声阶段优先考虑结构多样性，同时在低噪声阶段增强细粒度保真度。

sentences.en: During inference, a hierarchical  sampling strategy modulates the coherencealignment  trade-off, enabling precise control over  generation.
sentences.zh: 在推断时，一种分层采样策略调节连贯性-对齐权衡，从而实现对生成的精确控制。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate  that significantly outperforms existing baselines,  achieving state-of-the-art performance in both realism  and diversity.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有基线，在真实性和多样性方面都取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: AnomSeer: Reinforcing Multimodal LLMs to Reason for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
title_zh: AnomSeer：强化多模态大语言模型的推理能力以检测时间序列异常

sentences.en: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is an emerging area, yet a persistent challenge remains: MLLMs rely on coarse time-series heuristics but struggle with multi-dimensional, detailed reasoning, which is vital for understanding complex time-series data.
sentences.zh: 使用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行时间序列异常检测（TSAD）是一个新兴领域，但一个持续存在的挑战仍然存在：MLLM 依赖粗略的时间序列启发式，却在多维度、细节化的推理上困难重重，而这种推理对于理解复杂的时间序列数据至关重要。

sentences.en: We present AnomSeer to address this by reinforcing the model to ground its reasoning in precise, structural details of time series, unifying anomaly classification, localization, and explanation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 AnomSeer 以解决这一问题，通过强化模型使其推理扎根于时间序列精确、结构化的细节，统一异常分类、定位和解释。

sentences.en: At its core, an expert chain-of-thought trace  is generated to provide verifiable, fine-grained reasoning from classical analyses (e.g., statistical measures, frequency transforms).
sentences.zh: 在其核心，会生成一条专家思维链痕迹，从经典分析（例如，统计度量、频率变换）中提供可验证的、细粒度的推理。

sentences.en: Building on this, we propose a novel time-series grounded policy optimization (TimerPO) that incorporates two additional components beyond standard reinforcement learning: a time-series grounded advantage based on optimal transport and an orthogonal projection to ensure this auxiliary granular signal does not interfere with the primary detection objective.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们提出一种新颖的时间序列接地策略优化（TimerPO），它在标准强化学习之外还纳入了两个额外的组件：一个基于最优传输的时间序列接地的优势函数，以及一个正交投影，以确保这种辅助的细粒度信号不会干扰主要的检测目标。

sentences.en: Across diverse anomaly scenarios, AnomSeer, with Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct, outperforms larger commercial baselines  in classification and localization accuracy, particularly on point- and frequency-driven exceptions.
sentences.zh: 在各种异常场景中，使用 Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct 的 AnomSeer 在分类和定位准确率上优于更大的商业基线，尤其是在点和频率驱动的异常上。

sentences.en: Moreover, it produces plausible reasoning traces that support its conclusions.
sentences.zh: 此外，它产生的合理推理痕迹能够支持其结论。

title_en: Anti-Aliasing Matters: A Dynamic Network for Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: 抗混叠至关重要：用于时间序列预测的动态网络

sentences.en: Real-world time series inherently exhibit complex temporal patterns.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的时间序列固有地表现出复杂的时间模式。

sentences.en: Within chaotic systems, significant mixing and entanglement occur between different time-varying modes.
sentences.zh: 在混沌系统中，不同的时变模态之间会发生显著的混合和纠缠。

sentences.en: Given that time series exhibit distinctly different patterns at various sampling scales, downsampling to extract multiscale features is a common approach.
sentences.zh: 鉴于时间序列在不同的采样尺度上表现出截然不同的模式，通过下采样来提取多尺度特征是一种常见的方法。

sentences.en: However, conventional downsampling causes high-frequency components in the original signal, those exceeding the new Nyquist frequency, to undergo spectral folding.
sentences.zh: 然而，传统的下采样会导致原始信号中超过新的奈奎斯特（Nyquist）频率的高频分量发生频谱折叠。

sentences.en: This erroneously introduces spurious low-frequency patterns, perceived as low-frequency noise, thereby leading to the ***aliasing problem***.
sentences.zh: 这会错误地引入虚假的低频模式，被感知为低频噪声，从而引发***混叠问题***。

sentences.en: To address this problem, we propose a Decomposition-Prevention-Fusion architecture framework called **DMANet**, which introduces the **D**ynamic **M**ultiscale **A**nti-Aliasing **Net**work.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出一个称为 **DMANet** 的分解-预防-融合架构框架，它引入了**动态多尺度抗混叠网络（D**ynamic **M**ultiscale **A**nti-Aliasing **Net**work）**。

sentences.en: Specifically, DMANet comprises two key components: Multiscale Convolutional Downsampling, designed to capture temporal dependencies and inter-channel interactions, and an Anti-Aliasing Operation, which includes Pre-Sampling Anti-Aliasing Filtering and Post-Sampling Interpolation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，DMANet 由两个关键组件构成：多尺度卷积下采样，旨在捕捉时间依赖性和通道间交互；以及抗混叠操作，它包括采样前抗混叠滤波和采样后插值。

sentences.en: These designs guarantee the fidelity of multiscale features before and after downsampling.
sentences.zh: 这些设计保证了下采样前后多尺度特征的保真度。

sentences.en: We show that by mitigating the risk of aliasing, our proposed simple convolutional downsampling architecture achieves performance competitive with common baselines.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，通过缓解混叠风险，我们提出的简单卷积下采样架构能够实现与常见基线相当的竞争力性能。

sentences.en: Our codes are available at https://github.com/HenryZhou2024/DMANet.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/HenryZhou2024/DMANet 获取。

title_en: Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection via Cumulative Entropy
title_zh: 通过累积熵进行抗后门核心集选择

sentences.en: Recent training-time defenses against neural backdoors isolate a benign subset from poisoned training data, to learn a backdoor-free model from it.
sentences.zh: 近期针对神经后门的训练时防御，会从中毒的训练数据中隔离出一个良性子集，并从中学习一个无后门模型。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formulate this defense strategy as a coreset selection problem, giving rise to so-called “Anti-Backdoor Coreset Selection.”
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们将这一防御策略表述为一个核心集选择（coreset selection）问题，从而诞生了所谓的“抗后门核心集选择”。

sentences.en: Since poisonous samples have a) lower prediction uncertainty and are b) less frequent than benign samples, coreset selection naturally focuses more on samples associated with benign functionality than the backdoor functionality.
sentences.zh: 由于有毒样本 a）具有更低的预测不确定性，并且 b）比良性样本更不频繁，因此核心集选择自然地更关注与良性功能相关联的样本，而非与后门功能相关联的样本。

sentences.en: We use the Cumulative Entropy as selection criterion to further facilitate this effect.
sentences.zh: 我们使用累积熵（Cumulative Entropy）作为选择准则，以进一步促进这一效果。

sentences.en: The metric tracks the learning dynamics of training samples and allowing us to select benign samples with high informativeness for the coreset.
sentences.zh: 该指标追踪训练样本的学习动态，使我们能够为核心集选择信息量高的良性样本。

sentences.en: Additionally, we unlearn the chosen samples in each epoch to facilitate the separability between benign and poisonous samples.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们每个 epoch 都对选定的样本进行去学习（unlearn），以促进良性样本与有毒样本之间的可分性。

sentences.en: Together, this yields an exceptionally effective training-time defense that constructs a benign coreset to train a backdoor-free model.
sentences.zh: 综合起来，这产生了一种极其有效的训练时防御，它构建一个良性核心集来训练一个无后门模型。

sentences.en: Unlike prior defenses that compromise natural accuracy and fail against certain attacks, our method mitigates backdooring attacks consistently with a negligible impact on natural performance.
sentences.zh: 与那些损害自然准确率并对某些攻击失效的先前防御不同，我们的方法一致地缓解后门攻击，且对自然性能的影响可忽略不计。

sentences.en: The implementation of our method is publicly available at: https://intellisec.de/research/abcs
sentences.zh: 我们方法的实现可在 https://intellisec.de/research/abcs 公开获取。

title_en: Anti-causal domain generalization: Leveraging unlabeled data
title_zh: 反因果域泛化：利用无标签数据

sentences.en: The problem of domain generalization concerns learning predictive models that are robust to distribution shifts when deployed in new, previously unseen environments.
sentences.zh: 域泛化问题关注的是学习预测模型，使其在部署到新的、先前未见过的环境中时，对分布偏移具有鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Existing methods typically require labeled data from multiple training environments, limiting their applicability when labeled data are scarce.
sentences.zh: 现有的方法通常需要来自多个训练环境的标注数据，当标注数据稀缺时，这限制了它们的适用性。

sentences.en: In this work, we study domain generalization in an anti-causal setting, where the outcome causes the observed covariates.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究反因果（anti-causal）设置下的域泛化，其中结果（outcome）引起观测到的协变量。

sentences.en: Under this structure, environment perturbations that affect the covariates do not propagate to the outcome, which motivates regularizing the model's sensitivity to these perturbations.
sentences.zh: 在这一结构下，影响协变量的环境扰动不会传播到结果，这启发我们对模型对这些扰动的敏感性进行正则化。

sentences.en: Crucially, estimating these perturbation directions does not require labels, enabling us to leverage unlabeled data from multiple environments.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，估计这些扰动方向不需要标签，使我们能够利用来自多个环境的未标注数据。

sentences.en: We propose two methods that penalize the model's sensitivity to variations in the mean and covariance of the covariates across environments, respectively, and prove that these methods have worst-case optimality guarantees under certain classes of environments.
sentences.zh: 我们提出两种方法，分别惩罚模型对跨环境的协变量均值和协方差变化的敏感性，并证明在某些类别的环境下，这些方法具有最坏情形的最优性保证。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate the empirical performance of our approach on a controlled physical system and a physiological signal dataset.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在一个受控物理系统和一个生理信号数据集上展示了我们方法的实证性能。

title_en: ANTiC: Adaptive Neural Temporal In Situ Compressor
title_zh: ANTiC：自适应神经时间原位压缩器

sentences.en: The persistent storage requirements for high-resolution, spatiotemporally evolving fields governed by large-scale and high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) have reached the petabyte-to-exabyte scale.
sentences.zh: 由大规模和高维偏微分方程（PDE）控制的高分辨率、时空演化场的持久存储需求，已达到拍字节到艾字节的规模。

sentences.en: Transient simulations modeling Navier-Stokes equations, magnetohydrodynamics, plasma physics, or binary black hole mergers generate data volumes that are prohibitive for modern high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructures.
sentences.zh: 对 Navier-Stokes 方程、磁流体动力学、等离子体物理或双黑洞合并进行建模的瞬态模拟，产生的数据量对现代高性能计算（HPC）基础设施而言是难以承受的。

sentences.en: To address this bottleneck, we introduce ANTIC (Adaptive Neural Temporal in situ Compressor), an end-to-end in situ compression pipeline.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一瓶颈，我们引入 ANTIC（自适应神经时间原位压缩器），一个端到端的原位压缩流水线。

sentences.en: ANTIC consists of an adaptive temporal selector tailored to high-dimensional physics that identifies and filters informative snapshots at simulation time, combined with a spatial neural compression module based on continual fine-tuning that learns residual updates between adjacent snapshots using neural fields.
sentences.zh: ANTIC 由一个针对高维物理量身定制的自适应时间选择器组成，它在仿真时识别并过滤信息丰富的快照，以及一个基于持续微调的空间神经压缩模块，它利用神经场学习相邻快照之间的残差更新。

sentences.en: By operating in a single streaming pass, ANTIC enables a combined compression of temporal and spatial components and effectively alleviates the need for explicit on-disk storage of entire time-evolved trajectories.
sentences.zh: 通过在单次流式传递中工作，ANTIC 实现了时间与空间分量的联合压缩，并有效缓解了对整个时间演化轨迹进行显式磁盘存储的需求。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that ANTIC achieves storage reductions of approximately $\sim 400\times$ for 2D Kolmogorov flow simulations and $\sim 7000\times$ for large-scale physics simulations such as binary black hole mergers.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，ANTIC 对 2D Kolmogorov 流仿真实现了约 400 倍的存储缩减，对诸如双黑洞合并等大规模物理仿真实现了约 7000 倍的存储缩减。

title_en: Antidistillation Fingerprinting
title_zh: 反蒸馏指纹识别

sentences.en: Model distillation enables efficient emulation of frontier large language models (LLMs), creating a need for robust mechanisms to detect when a third-party student model has trained on a teacher model's outputs.
sentences.zh: 模型蒸馏使得高效地模拟前沿大语言模型（LLM）成为可能，因此产生了对稳健机制的需求，以检测第三方学生模型是否在教师模型输出上进行了训练。

sentences.en: However, existing fingerprinting techniques that could be used to detect such distillation rely on heuristic perturbations that impose a steep trade-off between generation quality and fingerprinting strength, often requiring significant degradation of utility to ensure the fingerprint is effectively internalized by the student.
sentences.zh: 然而，可用于检测此类蒸馏的现有指纹识别技术依赖启发式扰动，这些扰动在生成质量与指纹强度之间强加了一个陡峭的权衡，往往需要显著的效用退化，才能确保指纹被学生模型有效内化。

sentences.en: We introduce ***antidistillation fingerprinting*** (ADFP), a principled approach that aligns the fingerprinting objective with the student's learning dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们引入***抗蒸馏指纹识别***（ADFP），一种将指纹识别目标与学生模型学习动态对齐的原则性方法。

sentences.en: Building upon the gradient-based framework of *antidistillation sampling*, ADFP utilizes a proxy model to identify and sample tokens that directly maximize the expected detectability of the fingerprint in the student after fine-tuning, rather than relying on the incidental absorption of the un-targeted biases of a more naive watermark.
sentences.zh: 建立在*抗蒸馏采样*的基于梯度的框架之上，ADFP 利用一个代理模型来识别和采样那些能够直接最大化学生模型在微调后指纹期望可检测性的 token，而非依赖更朴素的、未定向偏置的水印被偶然吸收。

sentences.en: Experiments on GSM8K, OASST1, and MBPP demonstrate that ADFP achieves a significant Pareto improvement over state-of-the-art baselines, yielding stronger detection confidence with minimal impact on utility across mathematical reasoning, dialogue, and code generation, even when the student model's architecture is unknown.
sentences.zh: 在 GSM8K、OASST1 和 MBPP 上的实验表明，ADFP 相对最先进的基线取得了显著的帕累托改进，在数学推理、对话和代码生成领域以对效用的最小影响实现更强的检测置信度，即使学生模型的架构未知时也是如此。

title_en: Any-dimensional invariant universality
title_zh: 任意维度下的不变通用性

sentences.en: Several machine learning models are defined for inputs of any size, such as graphs with different numbers of nodes and point clouds with varying numbers of points.
sentences.zh: 若干机器学习模型是为任意大小的输入定义的，例如具有不同节点数的图和具有不同点数的点云。

sentences.en: The universality properties of such any-dimensional models remain poorly understood, as universality is traditionally studied for models accepting inputs of a fixed size, defined on a compact subset of their domain.
sentences.zh: 此类任意维模型的普适性性质仍然鲜为人知，因为普适性传统上是对接受固定大小输入、定义在其定义域紧子集上的模型进行研究的。

sentences.en: In sharp contrast, any-dimensional models can be viewed as sequences of functions defined on growing-sized inputs, and it is not clear in which sense they can be universal.
sentences.zh: 与此形成鲜明对比的是，任意维模型可以被视为定义在尺寸增长输入上的函数序列，而以何种意义它们能够普适并不清楚。

sentences.en: We develop a systematic approach to establish any-dimensional universality by identifying any-dimensional functions with a unique function that takes inputs in a suitable infinite-dimensional limit space containing inputs of all finite sizes, as well as their limits.
sentences.zh: 我们发展了一种系统性的方法，通过将任意维函数与一个唯一的函数（该函数在包含所有有限尺寸输入及其极限的合适无穷维极限空间中接受输入）视为同一，来建立任意维普适性。

sentences.en: Using the symmetries of these inputs and relations between inputs of different sizes, we show that this limit space admits a natural topology with rich families of compact sets on which any-dimensional universality can be established.
sentences.zh: 利用这些输入的对称性以及不同尺寸输入之间的关系，我们表明这一极限空间允许一种自然拓扑，具有丰富的紧集族，在这些紧集上可以建立任意维普适性。

sentences.en: We illustrate our approach by showing that several existing architectures fail to be universal, and we propose simple modifications that restore universality.
sentences.zh: 我们通过表明若干现有架构不能普适来说明我们的方法，并提出恢复普适性的简单修改。

title_en: Any-Order GPT as Masked Diffusion Model: Decoupling Formulation and Architecture
title_zh: 将任意顺序 GPT 视为掩码扩散模型：解耦形式化表述与架构

sentences.en: Efficiently scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) necessitates exploring alternatives to dominant autoregressive (AR) methods, with Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) emerging as candidates.
sentences.zh: 高效地扩展大语言模型（LLM）需要探索主导的自回归（AR）方法的替代方案，而掩码扩散模型（MDM）正成为候选者。

sentences.en: However, comparing AR (typically decoder-only) and MDM (often encoder-only) paradigms is confounded by differing architectures, obscuring true algorithmic and efficiency trade-offs.
sentences.zh: 然而，比较 AR（通常是纯解码器）和 MDM（通常是纯编码器）范式会因架构不同而产生混淆，掩盖了真正的算法和效率权衡。

sentences.en: This research decouples these factors by evaluating MDMs within a decoder-only framework to: (1) Equitably compare MDM (as Any-Order AR) and standard AR paradigms through discrepancies on orders.
sentences.zh: 本研究通过在一个纯解码器框架内评估 MDM 来解耦这些因素，以便：（1）通过阶数上的差异，公平地比较 MDM（作为任意阶 AR）与标准 AR 范式。

sentences.en: (2) Investigate MDM architectural impacts on computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: （2）研究 MDM 架构对计算效率的影响。

sentences.en: We show decoder-only MDMs, despite a larger modeling space, can achieve significant inference speedups ($\sim25\times$) and comparable perplexity with techniques like temperature annealing, offering a path to reduced inference compute.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，尽管解码器型 MDM 具有更大的建模空间，它仍能借助诸如温度退火等技术实现显著的推断加速（约 25 倍）和可比的困惑度，为减少推断计算提供了一条路径。

sentences.en: This work provides insights for developing more computationally efficient foundation models by disentangling core modeling choices from architectural influences.
sentences.zh: 本工作通过将核心建模选择与架构影响解耦，为开发计算上更高效的基础模型提供了洞见。

title_en: Any2Any: Unified Arbitrary Modality Translation for Remote Sensing
title_zh: Any2Any：遥感中的统一任意模态转换

sentences.en: Multi-modal remote sensing imagery provides complementary observations of the same geographic scene, yet such observations are frequently incomplete in practice.
sentences.zh: 多模态遥感影像提供了对同一地理场景的互补观测，然而在实践中这些观测往往是不完整的。

sentences.en: Existing cross-modal translation methods treat each modality pair as an independent task, resulting in quadratic complexity and limited generalization to unseen modality combinations.
sentences.zh: 现有的跨模态翻译方法将每一对模态视为独立任务，导致二次复杂度，并且对未见过的模态组合泛化有限。

sentences.en: We formulate Any-to-Any translation as inference over a shared latent representation of the scene, where different modalities correspond to partial observations of the same underlying semantics.
sentences.zh: 我们将任意到任意（Any-to-Any）翻译表述为对场景共享潜在表示的推断，其中不同的模态对应于同一底层语义的部分观测。

sentences.en: Based on this formulation, we propose Any2Any, a unified latent diffusion framework that projects heterogeneous inputs into a geometrically aligned latent space.
sentences.zh: 基于这一表述，我们提出 Any2Any，一个统一的潜在扩散框架，它将异构输入投影到一个几何对齐的潜在空间中。

sentences.en: Such structure performs anchored latent regression with a shared backbone, decoupling modality-specific representation learning from semantic mapping.
sentences.zh: 这种结构以共享骨干执行锚定潜在回归，将模态特定的表示学习与语义映射解耦。

sentences.en: Moreover, lightweight target-specific residual adapters are used to correct systematic latent mismatches without increasing inference complexity.
sentences.zh: 此外，轻量级的目标特定残差适配器被用来纠正系统性的潜在不匹配，而不会增加推断复杂度。

sentences.en: To support learning under sparse but connected supervision, we introduce RST-1M, the first million-scale remote sensing dataset with paired observations across five sensing modalities, providing supervision anchors for any-to-any translation.
sentences.zh: 为了支持在稀疏但连通的监督下进行学习，我们引入 RST-1M，第一个拥有跨五种传感模态配对观测的百万级遥感数据集，为任意到任意翻译提供监督锚点。

sentences.en: Experiments across 14 translation tasks show that Any2Any consistently outperforms pairwise translation methods and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to unseen modality pairs.
sentences.zh: 跨 14 项翻译任务的实验表明，Any2Any 一致地优于成对翻译方法，并对未见过的模态对展现出强劲的零样本泛化能力。

sentences.en: Code and models are available at https://github.com/MiliLab/Any2Any.
sentences.zh: 代码和模型可在 https://github.com/MiliLab/Any2Any 获取。

title_en: Any3D-VLA: Enhancing VLA Robustness via Diverse Point Clouds
title_zh: Any3D-VLA：通过多样化点云增强视觉–语言–动作模型的鲁棒性

sentences.en: Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically take 2D images as visual input, which limits their spatial understanding in complex scenes.
sentences.zh: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常以 2D 图像作为视觉输入，这限制了它们在复杂场景中的空间理解。

sentences.en: How can we incorporate 3D information to enhance VLA capabilities?
sentences.zh: 我们如何纳入 3D 信息来增强 VLA 的能力？

sentences.en: We conduct a pilot study across different observation spaces and visual representations.
sentences.zh: 我们在不同的观测空间和视觉表示上开展了一项先导研究。

sentences.en: The results show that explicitly lifting visual input into point clouds yields representations that better complement their corresponding 2D representations.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，将视觉输入显式地提升为点云，能够产生与其对应的 2D 表示更互补的表示。

sentences.en: To address the challenges of (1) scarce 3D data and (2) the domain gap induced by cross-environment differences and depth-scale biases, we propose Any3D-VLA.
sentences.zh: 为了应对（1）3D 数据稀缺和（2）由跨环境差异与深度尺度偏差所诱发的领域差距等挑战，我们提出 Any3D-VLA。

sentences.en: It unifies the simulator, sensor, and model-estimated point clouds within a training pipeline, constructs diverse inputs, and learns domain-agnostic 3D representations that are fused with the corresponding 2D representations.
sentences.zh: 它在训练流水线中统一了模拟器、传感器和模型估计的点云，构建多样化的输入，并学习与对应 2D 表示融合的领域无关 3D 表示。

sentences.en: Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate Any3D-VLA's advantages in improving performance and mitigating the domain gap.
sentences.zh: 仿真和真实世界的实验证明了 Any3D-VLA 在提升性能和缓解领域差距方面的优势。

sentences.en: Our project homepage is available at https://xianzhefan.github.io/Any3D-VLA.github.io.
sentences.zh: 我们的项目主页可在 https://xianzhefan.github.io/Any3D-VLA.github.io 获取。

title_en: AnyBand-Diff: A Unified Remote Sensing Image Generation and Band Repair Framework with Spectral Priors
title_zh: AnyBand-Diff：融合光谱先验的统一遥感图像生成与波段修复框架

sentences.en: Existing diffusion models have made significant progress in generating realistic images.
sentences.zh: 现有的扩散模型在生成逼真图像方面取得了显著进展。

sentences.en: However, their direct adaptation to remote sensing imagery often disregards intrinsic physical laws.
sentences.zh: 然而，将它们直接适配到遥感影像时，往往忽视了内在的物理规律。

sentences.en: This oversight frequently leads to spectral distortion and radiometric inconsistency, severely limiting the scientific utility of generated data.
sentences.zh: 这种疏忽常常导致光谱失真和辐射度不一致，严重限制了生成数据的科学效用。

sentences.en: To address this issue, this paper introduces AnyBand-Diff, a novel spectral-prior-guided diffusion framework tailored for robust spectral reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，本文引入 AnyBand-Diff，一个为稳健光谱重建量身定制的、新颖的光谱先验引导扩散框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we design a Masked Conditional Diffusion backbone integrated with a dual stochastic masking strategy, empowering the model to recover complete spectral information from arbitrary band subsets.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们设计了一个与双重随机掩码策略相结合的掩码条件扩散骨干，使模型能够从任意波段子集中恢复完整的光谱信息。

sentences.en: Subsequently, to ensure radiometric fidelity, a Physics-Guided Sampling mechanism is proposed, leveraging gradients from a differentiable physical model to explicitly steer the denoising trajectory toward the manifold of physically plausible solutions.
sentences.zh: 随后，为了确保辐射保真度，我们提出一种物理引导的采样机制，利用来自可微物理模型的梯度，将去噪轨迹显式地导向物理上合理解的流形。

sentences.en: Furthermore, a Multi-Scale Physical Loss is formulated to enforce rigorous constraints across pixel, region, and global levels in a joint manner.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们构建了一个多尺度物理损失，以在像素、区域和全局层面联合施加强约束。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments confirm the effectiveness of AnyBand-Diff in generating reliable imagery and achieving accurate spectral reconstruction, contributing to the advancement of physics-aware generative methods for Earth observation.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验证实了 AnyBand-Diff 在生成可靠影像和实现精确光谱重建方面的有效性，为地球观测中物理感知生成方法的发展做出了贡献。

title_en: AnyCanvas: Potential Field Guidance for Training-Free Spatial Control in Text-to-Image Diffusion
title_zh: AnyCanvas：通过势场引导实现文生图扩散模型无需训练的空间控制

sentences.en: Diffusion-based text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated remarkable advancements in generating high-quality images.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的文本到图像（T2I）模型在生成高质量图像方面展现了显著的进展。

sentences.en: However, while real-world applications like product packaging and logo design necessitate synthesis within irregular geometries, existing methods struggle to handle such constraints.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然产品包装和标志设计等现实应用需要在非规则几何形状内进行合成，但现有的方法在处理此类约束时仍然困难重重。

sentences.en: Therefore, generating complete pictures that conform to arbitrary-shaped canvas constraints while maintaining semantic integrity remains a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 因此，在保持语义完整性的同时，生成符合任意形状画布约束的完整图片仍然是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce AnyCanvas, a training-free framework that leverages a Mask-to-Potential Field paradigm to convert binary masks into a differentiable potential field, which guides content to naturally converge within target regions.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们引入 AnyCanvas，一个免训练的框架，它利用掩码到势场（Mask-to-Potential Field）范式将二值掩码转换为可微的势场，从而引导内容自然地汇聚到目标区域内。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AnyCanvas achieves 4.23\% higher spatial adherence to user-specified constraints while maintaining 99.45\% of the semantic fidelity measured by CLIP score, leading to a superior harmonic mean of spatial and semantic metrics.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，AnyCanvas 对用户指定约束的空间遵从性提高了 4.23\%，同时保持了 CLIP 分数所衡量的 99.45\% 的语义保真度，从而在空间与语义指标的调和平均数方面取得了更优的结果。

sentences.en: AnyCanvas also exhibits robust generalizability across different model backbones and versatile spatial control objectives.
sentences.zh: AnyCanvas 还展现出跨不同模型骨干和多样化空间控制目标的稳健泛化能力。

title_en: AnyEdit++: Adaptive Long-Form Knowledge Editing via Bayesian Surprise
title_zh: AnyEdit++：通过贝叶斯惊异度实现自适应长文本知识编辑

sentences.en: Editing complex, long-form knowledge in Large Language Models remains a significant challenge due to the difficulty of maintaining generation coherence.
sentences.zh: 编辑大语言模型中的复杂、长形式知识仍然是一个重大挑战，因为难以维持生成的连贯性。

sentences.en: Existing autoregressive methods like AnyEdit alleviate length constraints but rely on Fixed-window Chunking, which disregards logical structure and compromises consistency.
sentences.zh: 诸如 AnyEdit 等现有的自回归方法缓解了长度约束，但依赖固定窗口分块，这种做法忽视了逻辑结构并损害了一致性。

sentences.en: To address this, we present AnyEdit++, a structure-aware framework incorporating Bayes-Chunk, an adaptive segmentation mechanism that dynamically identifies semantic boundaries based on Bayesian Surprise.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出 AnyEdit++，一个结构感知的框架，它纳入了 Bayes-Chunk，一种基于贝叶斯惊奇（Bayesian Surprise）动态识别语义边界的自适应分段机制。

sentences.en: We underpin this approach with a theoretical framework establishing two key principles: (1) Structural Independence: we prove that cross-segment interference is minimized when anchor keys are geometrically orthogonal (a condition naturally satisfied by our surprisal-based boundaries but violated by fixed windows), and (2) Causal Locality: we demonstrate that updates injected at these semantic peaks yield strictly superior control compared to arbitrary split points.
sentences.zh: 我们用理论框架支撑这一方法，确立了两个关键原则：（1）结构独立性：我们证明当锚定键在几何上正交时（这一条件由我们基于惊奇的边界自然满足，但被固定窗口违反），跨段干扰被最小化；（2）因果局部性：我们证明在这些语义峰处注入的更新，相比任意的分割点，能够产生严格更优的控制。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and narrative tasks demonstrate that AnyEdit++ achieves superior performance and robustness compared to state-of-the-art baselines, validating that structural awareness is critical for effective long-form knowledge editing.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理、代码生成和叙事任务上的大量实验表明，AnyEdit++ 相比最先进的基线取得了更优的性能和鲁棒性，验证了结构感知对于有效长形式知识编辑至关重要。

title_en: AnyMod-LLVE: Low-Light Video Enhancement with Modality-Agnostic Inference
title_zh: AnyMod-LLVE：采用模态无关推理的低光视频增强

sentences.en: Low-light video enhancement (LLVE) remains a challenging task due to severe information degradation under low-illumination conditions.
sentences.zh: 低光照视频增强（LLVE）仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，因为低照度条件下的信息严重退化。

sentences.en: Recent multimodal approaches have significantly improved enhancement performance by incorporating auxiliary modalities, such as event streams and infrared images.
sentences.zh: 近期的多模态方法通过纳入辅助模态（如事件流和红外图像）显著提升了增强性能。

sentences.en: However, these methods typically assume the availability of these modalities at inference, which is often not feasible in real-world scenarios.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法通常假设这些模态在推断时可用，而这在真实世界场景中往往是不可行的。

sentences.en: To solve this problem, in this work, we propose AMNet, a unified multimodal framework for LLVE, to support flexible modality-agnostic inference, where auxiliary modalities may be unavailable.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，在本工作中，我们提出 AMNet，一个用于 LLVE 的统一多模态框架，以支持灵活的模态无关推断，其中辅助模态可能不可用。

sentences.en: To address the issue of modality absence, we introduce a Spatial-Spectral Dual-Gated Translator that learns the correspondence between auxiliary modalities and RGB inputs, producing implicit auxiliary representations to support the robust enhancement.
sentences.zh: 为了解决模态缺失的问题，我们引入一个空间-光谱双门控转换器，它学习辅助模态与 RGB 输入之间的对应关系，产生隐式的辅助表示以支持稳健的增强。

sentences.en: Additionally, to fully facilitate the learning of cross-modal correspondence, we conduct large-scale multimodal pretraining based on the RGB-only dataset with synthetic auxiliary modalities.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了充分促进跨模态对应关系的学习，我们基于仅 RGB 的数据集配合合成辅助模态，进行了大规模的多模态预训练。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AMNet could handle arbitrary inference-time modality combinations and exhibits superior performance for LLVE under modality absence conditions.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，AMNet 能够处理任意的推断时模态组合，并在模态缺失条件下展现出优越的 LLVE 性能。

sentences.en: Code and models are available on the project page.
sentences.zh: 代码和模型可在项目页面获取。

title_en: Anytime Detection of Strategic Deviations in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 多智能体系统中策略偏离的任意时刻检测

sentences.en: In many multi-agent systems, agents interact repeatedly and are expected to settle into stable, rational behavior over time.
sentences.zh: 在许多多智能体系统中，智能体反复交互，并期望它们随时间沉淀为稳定、理性的行为。

sentences.en: Yet in practice, behavior often drifts, and detecting such deviations in real time remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，行为往往会漂移，而实时检测此类偏离仍然是一个开放性挑战。

sentences.en: We introduce a sequential testing framework that monitors whether observed play is consistent with a benchmark of strategic behavior, without assuming a fixed sample size.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个序贯检验框架，它在不假设固定样本量的情况下，监测观察到的对局是否与某种策略性行为基准一致。

sentences.en: Our approach builds on the e-value framework for safe anytime-valid inference: by "betting" against the benchmark, we construct a test supermartingale that accumulates evidence whenever observed payoffs systematically violate the expected conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法建立在用于安全随时有效推断（safe anytime-valid inference）的 e-value 框架之上：通过“押注”对抗基准，我们构造一个检验鞅（test supermartingale），每当观察到的收益系统性违反预期条件时，它就会累积证据。

sentences.en: For repeated normal-form games, we take equilibrium as the benchmark, yielding a statistically sound, interpretable measure of departure from equilibrium that can be monitored online; our framework unifies the treatment of Nash, correlated, and coarse correlated equilibria, offering finite-time guarantees and a detailed analysis of detection times.
sentences.zh: 对于重复的正则型博弈，我们以均衡作为基准，得到一种统计健全、可解释的均衡偏离度量，它可以被在线监测；我们的框架统一了纳什均衡、相关均衡和粗相关均衡的处理，提供有限时间保证和对检测时间的详细分析。

sentences.en: We also leverage Benjamini-Hochberg-type procedures to increase detection power in large games while rigorously controlling the false discovery rate.
sentences.zh: 我们还利用 Benjamini-Hochberg 类型的程序来提升大型博弈中的检测能力，同时严格控制错误发现率。

sentences.en: Finally, we extend our method to stochastic games, verifying online whether observed trajectories adhere to a specified target policy, such as a computed equilibrium, broadening the framework's applicability to dynamic, state-dependent settings.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们将方法扩展到随机博弈，在线验证观察到的轨迹是否遵循指定的目标策略（例如一个计算得到的均衡），将框架的适用性扩展到动态、状态依赖的设置。

title_en: Anytime Safe PAC Efficient Reasoning
title_zh: 任意时刻安全的 PAC 高效推理

sentences.en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex tasks but suffer from high computational costs and latency.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）在复杂任务上展现了卓越的性能，但受到高计算成本和延迟的困扰。

sentences.en: While selective thinking strategies improve efficiency by routing easy queries to non-thinking models, existing approaches often incur uncontrollable errors, especially in online settings where the performance loss of a non-thinking model is only partially observed and data are non-stationary.
sentences.zh: 虽然选择性思考策略通过将简单查询路由到非思考模型来提高效率，但现有的方法往往产生不可控的错误，尤其是在在线设置中，非思考模型的性能损失仅被部分观测到，且数据是非平稳的。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose *Betting Probably Approximately Correct* (B-PAC) *reasoning*, a principled method that enables anytime safe and efficient online reasoning under partial feedback.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出*押注型可能近似正确*（Betting Probably Approximately Correct，B-PAC）*推理*，一种在部分反馈下实现随时安全且高效的在线推理的原则性方法。

sentences.en: Specifically, we utilize inverse propensity scoring estimators to construct test supermartingales for candidate thresholds, and then dynamically adjust the routing threshold based on the accumulated statistical evidence of safety.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们利用逆倾向得分估计器为候选阈值构造检验鞅，然后基于累积的安全统计证据动态调整路由阈值。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we establish the anytime-valid performance loss control and the efficiency of B-PAC reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们确立了 B-PAC 推理的随时有效性能损失控制和效率。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that B-PAC reasoning significantly reduces computational overhead, decreasing thinking model usage by up to 81.01\%, while controlling the performance loss below the user-specified level.
sentences.zh: 大量的实验表明，B-PAC 推理显著降低了计算开销，将思考模型的使用率降低了多达 81.01\%，同时将性能损失控制在用户指定水平以下。
